function v_u_1.table_eq(p46, p47) -- name: table_eq
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1

	local function v_u_60(p49, p50) -- name: recurse
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_60

			return false
		end

			return p49 == p50
		end

			return v_u_48[p49] == p50
		end

				for v58, v59 in ipairs(v52) do
					if not (v_u_1.table_eq(v54, v59) and v_u_60(v55, p50[v59])) then

					return false
				end
				v51[v54] = nil
				if v_u_60(v55, v56) then

function v_u_1.tostring_table(p154) -- name: tostring_table
	if not p154 then
		return "nil"
	end
	local v155 = {}
	local v156 = "{\n"
	local v157 = {}
	local v158 = {}
	local v159 = 1
	while true do
		local v160 = 0
		for _, _ in pairs(p154) do
			v160 = v160 + 1
		end
		local v161 = 1
		for v162, v163 in pairs(p154) do
			if v155[p154] == nil or v155[p154] <= v161 then
				if string.find(v156, "}", v156:len()) then
					v156 = v156 .. ",\n"
				elseif not string.find(v156, "\n", v156:len()) then
					v156 = v156 .. "\n"
				end
				table.insert(v158, v156)
				local v164 = ""
				local v165
				if type(v162) == "number" or type(v162) == "boolean" then
					v165 = "[" .. tostring(v162) .. "]"
				else
					v165 = "[\'" .. tostring(v162) .. "\']"
				end
				local v166
				if type(v163) == "number" or type(v163) == "boolean" then
					local v167 = ""
					for _ = 1, v159 do
						v167 = v167 .. "    "
					end
					v166 = v164 .. v167 .. v165 .. " = " .. tostring(v163)
				else
					if type(v163) == "table" then
						local v168 = ""
						for _ = 1, v159 do
							v168 = v168 .. "    "
						end
						v156 = v164 .. v168 .. v165 .. " = {\n"
						table.insert(v157, p154)
						table.insert(v157, v163)
						v155[p154] = v161 + 1
					end
					local v169 = ""
					for _ = 1, v159 do
						v169 = v169 .. "    "
					end
					v166 = v164 .. v169 .. v165 .. " = \'" .. tostring(v163) .. "\'"
				end
				if v161 == v160 then
					local v170 = ""
					local v171 = "\n"
					for _ = 1, v159 - 1 do
						v170 = v170 .. "    "
					end
					v156 = v166 .. v171 .. v170 .. "}"
				else
					v156 = v166 .. ","
				end
			elseif v161 == v160 then
				local v172 = ""
				local v173 = "\n"
				for _ = 1, v159 - 1 do
					v172 = v172 .. "    "
				end
				v156 = v156 .. v173 .. v172 .. "}"
			end
			v161 = v161 + 1
		end
		if v160 == 0 then
			local v174 = ""
			local v175 = "\n"
			for _ = 1, v159 - 1 do
				v174 = v174 .. "    "
			end
			v156 = v156 .. v175 .. v174 .. "}"
		end
		if #v157 <= 0 then
			table.insert(v158, v156)
			return table.concat(v158)
		end
		p154 = v157[#v157]
		v157[#v157] = nil
		v159 = v155[p154] == nil and v159 + 1 or v159 - 1
	end
end

function v_u_1.search_match_rank(p185, p186) -- name: search_match_rank
	local v187 = string.gsub(p185, "%.", "")
	local v188 = string.gsub(p186, "%.", "")
	local v189 = string.find(v187, v188, 1, true)
	if not v189 then
		return nil
	end
	if v189 == 1 then
		return 1
	end
	while v189 do
		local v190 = string.find
		local v191 = v189 - 1
		local v192 = v189 - 1
		if not v190(string.sub(v187, v191, v192), "%w") then

		end

	end

end

function v_u_1.line_intersection(p305, p306, p307, p308) -- name: line_intersection
	local v309 = p305.X
	local v310 = p305.Z
	local v311 = p306.X
	local v312 = p306.Z
	local v313 = p307.X
	local v314 = p307.Z
	local v315 = p308.X
	local v316 = p308.Z
	local v317 = 0 - 0
	if math.abs(v317) < 0.01 then
		return nil
	end
	local v318 = v309 / v311 % 2 == 1
	local v319 = v313 / v315 % 2 == 1
	if v318 and v319 then
		return nil
	end
	local v320
	if v318 then
		local v321 = (v314 - v316) / (v313 - v315)
		local v322 = -(v321 * v313) + v314
		v320 = v321 * v309 + v322
	elseif v319 then
		local v323 = (v310 - v312) / (v309 - v311)
		local v324 = -(v323 * v309) + v310
		v320 = v323 * v313 + v324
		v309 = v313
	else
		local v325 = (v310 - v312) / (v309 - v311)
		local v326 = (v314 - v316) / (v313 - v315)
		if v325 == v326 then
			return nil
		end
		local v327 = -(v325 * v309) + v310
		v309 = (-(v326 * v313) + v314 - v327) / (v325 - v326)
		v320 = v325 * v309 + v327
	end
	return Vector3.new(v309, v310, v320)
end

function v_u_1.shuffle(p381) -- name: shuffle
	for v382 = #p381, 2, -1 do

	end
end
function v_u_1.format_hms_time(p386) -- name: format_hms_time

	local v389 = math.floor(v388) % 60
	local v390 = p386 / 60 / 60
	local v391 = math.floor(v390)
	if v391 > 0 then
		return string.format("%02dh %02dm", v391, v389)
	else
		return string.format("%02dm %02ds", v389, v387)
	end
end
function v_u_1.calc_exp(p392, p393, p394, p395) -- name: calc_exp
	local v396 = p395 / p393
	local v397 = 1 / (p394 - p392)

end

function v_u_1.is_equal(p407, p408, p409) -- name: is_equal
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1

	if v410 ~= type(p408) then
		return false

		return false
	end
	if p409 then
		local v411 = getmetatable(p407)
		if v411 and v411.__eq then
			return p407 == p408
		end
	end
	local v412 = {}
	for v413, v414 in pairs(p407) do
		local v415 = p408[v413]
		if v415 == nil or v_u_1.is_equal(v414, v415, p409) == false then

	end

		end

function v_u_1.concat_iter(p_u_418) -- name: concat_iter

	assert(v419, "expected a table of arrays")
	local v_u_420 = 1
	local v_u_421 = 0
	local v_u_422 = p_u_418[v_u_420]
	return function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_422, (ref) v_u_421, (ref) v_u_420, (copy) p_u_418
		while v_u_422 do
			v_u_421 = v_u_421 + 1

				return v423
			end

			v_u_421 = 0
		end

	end

function v_u_1.flatten_reward_tables(p424) -- name: flatten_reward_tables
	local function v_u_431(p425, p426) -- name: deepCopy
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_431
		if type(p425) ~= "table" then
			return p425
		end
		local v427 = p426 or {}
		if v427[p425] then
			return v427[p425]
		end
		local v428 = {}
		v427[p425] = v428
		for v429, v430 in pairs(p425) do
			v428[v_u_431(v429, v427)] = v_u_431(v430, v427)
		end
		return v428
	end
	local function v_u_436(p432) -- name: normalizedAmount
		local v433 = p432.amount
		if v433 == nil then
			v433 = (p432.min_amount == nil or p432.max_amount == nil) and 1 or {
				["min_amount"] = p432.min_amount,
				["max_amount"] = p432.max_amount
			}
		end
		if type(v433) == "table" then
			local v434 = v433.min_amount or v433.min
			local v435 = v433.max_amount or v433.max
			if v434 == nil or v435 == nil then
				return ("O:%s"):format((tostring(v433))), v433
			elseif v434 == v435 then
				return ("F:%s"):format((tostring(v434))), v434
			else
				return ("R:%s:%s"):format(tostring(v434), (tostring(v435))), {
					["min_amount"] = v434,
					["max_amount"] = v435
				}
			end
		else
			return ("F:%s"):format((tostring(v433))), v433
		end
	end
	local function v_u_442(p437, p438) -- name: isSimpleDeterministic
		if p437._zero_chance ~= nil and p437._zero_chance ~= 0 then
			return false
		end
		local v439 = p437[p438]
		if type(v439) ~= "string" then
			return false
		end
		local v440 = p437.amount
		if type(v440) ~= "number" then
			return false
		end
		for v441, _ in pairs(p437) do
			if v441 == p438 or (v441 == "amount" or v441 == "_zero_chance") then
				continue
			end
			return false
		end
		return true
	end
	local v_u_443 = {
		["item"] = {},
		["unit"] = {}
	}
	local v444 = 0
	local v445 = {}
	local function v452(p446, p447) -- name: mergeAllListInto
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_431, (copy) v_u_436, (copy) v_u_443
		for _, v448 in ipairs(p447) do
			local v449 = v_u_431(v448)
			local _, v450 = v_u_436(v449)
			v449.amount = v450
			v449.min_amount = nil
			v449.max_amount = nil
			v449.chance = nil
			local v451 = v_u_443[p446]
			table.insert(v451, v449)
		end
	end
	local function v483(p453, p454, p455) -- name: tryCollapseOneOfToAll
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_436, (copy) v_u_431
		if not p453 or #p453 <= 0 then
			return "empty"
		end
		local v456 = 0
		local v457 = 0
		local v458 = 0
		local v459 = nil
		local v460 = true
		local v461 = nil
		local v462 = nil
		for _, v463 in ipairs(p453) do
			local v464 = v463.chance
			local v465 = v464 == nil and 1 or v464
			if v465 <= 0 then
				continue
			end
			v457 = v457 + 1
			v458 = v458 + v465
			local v466, v467 = v_u_436(v463)
			local v468 = v463[p454]
			local v469 = tostring(v468) .. "|" .. v466
			if v459 == nil then
				v461 = v_u_431(v463)
				v462 = v467
				v459 = v469
			elseif v469 ~= v459 then
				v460 = false
			end
			local v470 = v463._zero_chance
			v456 = v456 + v465 * (1 - (v470 == nil and 0 or (v470 < 0 and 0 or (v470 > 1 and 1 or v470))))
		end
		if v457 == 0 or v458 <= 0 then
			return "empty"
		end
		if v457 ~= 1 then
			if v460 and v461 then
				for v471, _ in pairs(v461) do
					if p455[v471] then
						continue
					end
					v472 = false
				end
				local v472 = true
				if v472 then
					for _, v473 in ipairs(p453) do
						local v474 = v473.chance
						if (v474 == nil and 1 or v474) <= 0 then
							continue
						end
						for v475, _ in pairs(v473) do
							if p455[v475] then
								continue
							end
							v476 = false
						end
						local v476 = true
						if v476 then
							break
						end
						return "keep"
					end
					local v477 = v456 / v458
					if v477 <= 0 then
						return "empty"
					end
					v461.chance = nil
					v461.amount = v462
					v461.min_amount = nil
					v461.max_amount = nil
					local v478 = 1 - v477
					local v479 = v478 == nil and 0 or (v478 < 0 and 0 or (v478 > 1 and 1 or v478))
					v461._zero_chance = v479 > 0 and v479 and v479 or nil
					return "mergeable", v461
				end
			end
			return "keep"
		end
		local v480 = v456 / v458
		if v480 <= 0 then
			return "empty"
		end
		v461.chance = nil
		v461.amount = v462
		v461.min_amount = nil
		v461.max_amount = nil
		local v481 = 1 - v480
		local v482 = v481 == nil and 0 or (v481 < 0 and 0 or (v481 > 1 and 1 or v481))
		v461._zero_chance = v482 > 0 and v482 and v482 or nil
		return "mergeable", v461
	end
	local function v492(p484, p485) -- name: combineDeterministic
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_442
		if not p484 or #p484 <= 0 then
			return p484
		end
		local v486 = {}
		local v487 = {}
		for _, v488 in ipairs(p484) do
			if v_u_442(v488, p485) then
				local v489 = v488[p485]
				v486[v489] = (v486[v489] or 0) + v488.amount
			else
				table.insert(v487, v488)
			end
		end
		for v490, v491 in pairs(v486) do
			if v491 == 0 then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(v487, {
				[p485] = v490,
				["amount"] = v491
			})
		end
		return v487
	end
	for _, v493 in ipairs(p424 or {}) do
		if type(v493) ~= "table" then
			continue
		end
		v444 = v444 + (v493.gem_reward or 0)
		if v493._item_multichoice or v493._unit_multichoice then
			local v494 = v_u_431(v493)
			v494.gem_reward = nil
			table.insert(v445, v494)
		else
			local v495 = v_u_431(v493)
			v495.gem_reward = nil
			for _, v496 in ipairs({ "item", "unit" }) do
				local v497 = v496 .. "_id"
				local v498 = "_reward_all_" .. v496 .. "s"
				local v499 = v495[v496]
				if v499 and #v499 > 0 then
					if v495[v498] then
						v452(v496, v499)
						v495[v496] = nil
						v495[v498] = nil
					else
						local v500, v501 = v483(v499, v497, {
							[v497] = true,
							["amount"] = true,
							["min_amount"] = true,
							["max_amount"] = true,
							["chance"] = true,
							["_zero_chance"] = true
						})
						if v500 == "mergeable" then
							local v502 = v_u_443[v496]
							table.insert(v502, v501)
							v495[v496] = nil
						else
							if v500 ~= "empty" then
								continue
							end
							v495[v496] = nil
						end
					end
				else
					v495[v496] = nil
					v495[v498] = nil
				end
			end
			if next(v495) == nil then
				break
			end
			table.insert(v445, v495)
		end
	end
	v_u_443.item = v492(v_u_443.item, "item_id")
	v_u_443.unit = v492(v_u_443.unit, "unit_id")
	if v_u_443.item and #v_u_443.item > 0 then
		v_u_443._reward_all_items = true
	else
		v_u_443.item = nil
	end
	if v_u_443.unit and #v_u_443.unit > 0 then
		v_u_443._reward_all_units = true
	else
		v_u_443.unit = nil
	end
	if v444 ~= 0 then
		if v_u_443._reward_all_items or v_u_443._reward_all_units then
			v_u_443.gem_reward = v444
		elseif #v445 > 0 then
			v445[1].gem_reward = v444
		else
			v_u_443.gem_reward = v444
		end
	end
	local v503 = {}
	if v_u_443.gem_reward ~= nil and v_u_443.gem_reward ~= 0 and true or (v_u_443._reward_all_items or v_u_443._reward_all_units) then
		if not (v_u_443._reward_all_items or v_u_443._reward_all_units) then
			v_u_443.item = nil
			v_u_443.unit = nil
		end
		table.insert(v503, v_u_443)
	end
	for _, v504 in ipairs(v445) do
		table.insert(v503, v504)
	end
	return v503
end
function v_u_1.flatten_multiply_reward_table(p505, p506) -- name: flatten_multiply_reward_table
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v507 = tonumber(p506) or 0
	local v508 = math.floor(v507)
	if v508 <= 0 or type(p505) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	local v509
	if p505.gem_reward == nil or (p505.item ~= nil or (p505.unit ~= nil or (p505._reward_all_items ~= nil or (p505._reward_all_units ~= nil or p505._item_multichoice ~= nil)))) then
		v509 = false
	else
		v509 = p505._unit_multichoice == nil
	end
	if v509 then
		local v510 = (p505.gem_reward or 0) * v508
		return v510 == 0 and {} or {
			{
				["gem_reward"] = v510
			}
		}
	end
	local v511 = table.create and (table.create(v508) or {}) or {}
	for v512 = 1, v508 do
		v511[v512] = p505
	end
	return v_u_1.flatten_reward_tables(v511)
end
return v_u_1

local function v_u_92(p80, p81) -- name: _step_thrown

	local v82 = p80.elapsed
	if p80.total_time <= v82 or p80.uiframe.Parent == nil then
		p80.uiframe:Destroy()
		return false
	end
	local v83, v84
	if v82 < p80.land_time then
		v83 = p80.up_speed * v82 - p80.gravity / 2 * v82 ^ 2
		v84 = v82
	else
		local v85 = v82 - p80.land_time
		local v86 = p80.floor_height + p80.bounce_speed * v85 - p80.gravity / 2 * v85 ^ 2
		local v87 = p80.floor_height
		v83 = math.max(v86, v87)
		v84 = p80.land_time + v85 * 0.5
	end

		p80.base = p80.HRP.Position
	end
	p80.uiframe.CFrame = CFrame.new(p80.base + p80.offset + p80.velocity * v84 + Vector3.new(0, v83, 0))
	if p80.fade_start <= v82 then
		local v88 = p80.row
		local v89 = (v82 - p80.fade_start) / (p80.total_time - p80.fade_start)
		local v90 = math.min(1, v89)

end

		end

		end

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.client.Services.EffectScripts.0.7794250072 [ModuleScript]
return {
	["init_dependencies"] = function() -- name: init_dependencies
		Loader = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Loader)
		TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
		Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
		FXUtil = Loader.load_client_service(script, "FXUtil")
		FullBodyParticles = Loader.get_assets_path().particles.full_body_particles
		ScaleParticle = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.imported.ScaleModel.ScaleParticle)
	end,
	["start"] = function(_, p1, p2) -- name: start
		local v3 = FullBodyParticles:FindFirstChild(p2.particle)
		local v4 = FullBodyParticles.ref:Clone()
		v4.CanCollide = false
		for _, v5 in pairs(v3:GetChildren()) do
			if not v5:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v5:FindFirstChild("_enabled") then
				continue
			end
			local v6 = v5:Clone()
			v6.Parent = v4
			v6.Enabled = false
		end
		local v7 = p1.root or p1.unit.HumanoidRootPart
		local v8 = v7.Size.X / 2
		if not p2.dont_scale then
			for _, v9 in pairs(v4:GetChildren()) do
				if not v9:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
					continue
				end
				ScaleParticle(v9, v8)
			end
		end
		v4.Size = v4.Size * v8
		v4.Parent = workspace.ignore
		v4.CFrame = v7.CFrame
		local v10 = Instance.new("Weld")
		v10.Part0 = v7
		v10.Part1 = v4
		v10.Parent = v7
		for _, v11 in pairs(v4:GetChildren()) do
			if not (v11:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and v11:FindFirstChild("_emit_rate")) then
				continue
			end
			v11:Emit(v11.Rate)
		end
		if v3:FindFirstChild("_time") then
			for _, v12 in pairs(v4:GetChildren()) do
				if not v12:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
					continue
				end
				v12.Enabled = true
			end
			task.wait(v3._time.Value)
		end
		FXUtil.slow_destroy_instance(v4)
		FXUtil.slow_destroy_instance(v10)
	end
}

local function v_u_37(p_u_21, p_u_22, p_u_23, p_u_24) -- name: _collapse

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_29, (copy) p_u_21, (ref) v_u_30, (copy) p_u_23, (copy) p_u_24, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) p_u_22

		TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
		Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
		FXUtil = Loader.load_client_service(script, "FXUtil")
		RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
		Bezier = Loader.load_core_service(script, "Bezier")
		RaycastUtil = Loader.load_core_service(script, "RaycastUtil")
		UnitServiceCore = Loader.load_core_service(script, "UnitServiceCore")
		RandomGenerator = Loader.load_core_service(script, "RandomGenerator")
		FX = Loader.get_assets_path()._new_fx.rikka.curse
	end,
	["start"] = function(_, p1, p2, p3) -- name: start
		local v4 = p1.unit
		local v5 = v4._root.Value
		if p2.stage == "eye" then
			local v6
			if v4.Head:FindFirstChild("cursed_eye_buff") then
				v6 = v4.Head:FindFirstChild("cursed_eye_buff")
			else
				v6 = FX.eye.Attachment2:Clone()
				v6.Parent = v4.Head
				v6.Name = "cursed_eye_buff"
				local v7 = Instance.new("PointLight")
				v7.Color = Color3.fromRGB(149, 56, 255)
				v7.Brightness = 4
				v7.Range = 0
				v7.Parent = v6
			end
			local v8 = FX.eye.Attachment:Clone()
			Debris:AddItem(v8, 5)
			v8.Parent = v4.Head
			FXUtil.emit_particles_with_delay(v8)
			if not p3.disable_effects then
				FXUtil.play_nonpersistent_sound(v5, "curse_1")
			end
			FXUtil.enable_particles(v6)
			TweenService:Create(v6.PointLight, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
				["Range"] = 6
			}):Play()
		elseif p2.stage == "eye_off" and v4.Head:FindFirstChild("cursed_eye_buff") then
			local v9 = v4.Head:FindFirstChild("cursed_eye_buff")
			FXUtil.disable_particles(v9)
			TweenService:Create(v9.PointLight, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
				["Range"] = 6
			}):Play()
		end
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.gojo_evolved [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, _, p_u_2) -- name: setup
		local v_u_3 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_2, (copy) v_u_3
			if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					return
				end
			end
			local v4
			if p_u_2 and (p_u_2.shiny or p_u_2.skin) then
				v4 = p_u_1.fakehead["Gojo face (Smiling)"]
			else
				v4 = p_u_1.fakehead["Gojo Face"]
			end
			local v_u_5 = p_u_1.fakehead:Clone()
			for _, v6 in pairs(v_u_5:GetChildren()) do
				v6:Destroy()
			end
			v_u_5.Anchored = false
			v_u_5.CanCollide = false
			v_u_5.CanQuery = false
			v_u_5.CanTouch = false
			if not p_u_2 or (not p_u_2.skin or p_u_2.skin._skin_id ~= "gojo_halloween") then
				v_u_5.Size = v_u_5.Size * 1.09
			end
			v4.Parent = v_u_5
			v4.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(524, 546, 850)
			local v_u_7 = p_u_1.fakehead
			p_u_1 = nil
			v_u_5.Parent = workspace.ignore
			v_u_3.weld(v_u_5, v_u_5, v_u_7)
			if p_u_2 and p_u_2.is_actual_pet then
				game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_5, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_2.uuid)
			end
			local v_u_8 = nil
			v_u_8 = v_u_7.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_8
				if not v_u_7:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					if v_u_5 then
						v_u_5:Destroy()
						v_u_5 = nil
					end
					v_u_7 = nil
					v_u_8:Disconnect()
					v_u_8 = nil
				end
			end)
			v_u_7:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_7
				if v_u_5 then
					v_u_5.Size = v_u_7.Size
				end
			end)
		end)
	end
}

			"Right Arm",
			"Left Leg"

					v5:Clone().Parent = p1[v4]

					v5:Clone().Parent = p1[v4]
				end
			end
		end
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.yuno_evolved [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p1, p2) -- name: setup
		local v3 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
		local v4 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.yuno_evolved
		local v5 = v4.particles
		for _, v6 in pairs({
			"Head",
			"Right Leg",
			"Right Arm",
			"Left Leg",
			"Torso"
		}) do
			if not v5:FindFirstChild(v6) then
				continue
			end
			local v7 = v5[v6]
			if v7:FindFirstChild(v6) then
				v7 = v7[v6]
			end
			for _, v8 in pairs(v7:GetChildren()) do
				v8:Clone().Parent = p1[v6]
			end
		end
		p1.fakehead:FindFirstChild("Decal"):Destroy()
		v4.face:Clone().Parent = p1.fakehead
		local v9 = v4.Back:Clone()
		v9.Parent = p1
		v3.weld(p1.Torso, p1.Torso, v9.PrimaryPart, CFrame.new(-1.85286713, 0.916539669, 0.498947144, 0.165985942, -1.76631634e-8, -0.986127675, -2.931837e-9, 1, 1.74181345e-8, 0.986127675, 6.77626358e-21, 0.165985942))
		local v10 = v4.Crown:Clone()
		v10.Parent = p1
		v3.weld(p1.Head, p1.Head, v10.PrimaryPart, CFrame.new(-0.151500702, 0.38435483, -0.0040435791, 0, -1.76622912e-8, -1, 0, 1, 1.76622912e-8, 1, 0, 0))
		local v11 = v4.CrownHand:Clone()
		v11.Parent = p1
		v3.weld(p1["Left Arm"], p1["Left Arm"], v11.PrimaryPart, CFrame.new(-0.0000801086426, -0.397638381, -0.0000610351562, 0, 1.76622894e-8, -1, 0, -0.999999821, 1.76622912e-8, -1, 0, 0))
		local v12 = v4.sword:Clone()
		v12.Parent = p1
		v3.weld(p1.LeftArmGear, p1.LeftArmGear, v12.PrimaryPart, CFrame.new(0.00438785553, -0.0167463422, -1.95797729, 0, -3.53243408e-8, 1, 0, 0.999999821, -3.53243337e-8, -1, 0, 0))
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts._grimoire_util [ModuleScript]

		v4.Parent = p2
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.ermes_evolved [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p1, p2) -- name: setup
		local v3 = p2.get_assets_path().dupe_limbs:Clone()
		v3.Parent = p1
		p2.load_core_service(script, "UnitServiceCore").disable_unused_humanoid_stats(v3.Humanoid)
		v3["Left Arm"].Weld.Part0 = p1:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
		v3["Right Arm"].Weld.Part0 = p1:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
		v3["Left Arm"].Color = p1:FindFirstChild("Left Arm").Color
		v3["Right Arm"].Color = p1:FindFirstChild("Right Arm").Color
		local v4 = p1:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Shirt")
		if v4 then
			v3:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Shirt").ShirtTemplate = v4.ShirtTemplate
		end
		if p1:FindFirstChild("StringStandAA") then
			v3["Left Arm"].Transparency = 1
			v3["Right Arm"].Transparency = 1
		end
		local v5 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.ermes
		for _, v6 in pairs({
			"Head",
			"Torso",
			"Right Arm",
			"Right Leg",
			"Left Arm",
			"Left Leg"
		}) do
			for _, v7 in pairs(v5:GetChildren()) do
				if v7:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
					v7:Clone().Parent = p1[v6]
				else
					if not v7:IsA("PointLight") or v6 ~= "Torso" then
						continue
					end
					v7:Clone().Parent = p1[v6]
				end
			end
		end
		for _, v8 in pairs({ v3["Left Arm"], v3["Right Arm"] }) do
			for _, v9 in pairs(v5:GetChildren()) do
				if not v9:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
					continue
				end
				v9:Clone().Parent = v8
			end
		end
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.pucci_heaven [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, p_u_2, p_u_3) -- name: setup
		if not p_u_3.shiny then
			local v_u_4 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) p_u_3
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
					if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						return
					end
				end
				local v_u_5 = p_u_1.fakehead
				local v_u_6 = p_u_2.get_assets_path().vfx.pucci_heaven_eyes:Clone()
				v_u_6.Parent = workspace.ignore
				v_u_4.weld(v_u_6, v_u_6, v_u_5)
				if p_u_3 and p_u_3.is_actual_pet then
					game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_6, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_3.uuid)
				end
				local v_u_7 = nil
				v_u_7 = v_u_5.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_7
					if not v_u_5:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						if v_u_6 then
							v_u_6:Destroy()
							v_u_6 = nil
						end
						v_u_5 = nil
						v_u_7:Disconnect()
						v_u_7 = nil
					end
				end)
				v_u_6.Size = v_u_5.Size
				v_u_5:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_5
					if v_u_6 then
						v_u_6.Size = v_u_5.Size
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.obito [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, _, p_u_2) -- name: setup
		local v_u_3 = p_u_2.shiny
		local v_u_4 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_1, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) p_u_2
			if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					return
				end
			end
			if v_u_3 then
				local v_u_5 = p_u_1.fakehead:Clone()
				p_u_1.fakehead.eyes:Destroy()
				for _, v6 in pairs(v_u_5:GetChildren()) do
					if v6.Name == "eyes" then
						continue
					end
					v6:Destroy()
				end
				v_u_5.Anchored = false
				v_u_5.CanCollide = false
				v_u_5.CanQuery = false
				v_u_5.CanTouch = false
				local v_u_7 = p_u_1.fakehead
				p_u_1 = nil
				v_u_5.Parent = workspace.ignore
				v_u_4.weld(v_u_5, v_u_5, v_u_7)
				if p_u_2 and p_u_2.is_actual_pet then
					game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_5, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_2.uuid)
				end
				local v_u_8 = nil
				v_u_8 = v_u_7.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_8
					if not v_u_7:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						if v_u_5 then
							v_u_5:Destroy()
							v_u_5 = nil
						end
						v_u_7 = nil
						v_u_8:Disconnect()
						v_u_8 = nil
					end
				end)
				v_u_7:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_7
					if v_u_5 then
						v_u_5.Size = v_u_7.Size
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.boros [ModuleScript]

	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, _, p_u_2) -- name: setup

			if not (p_u_2 and p_u_2.shiny) then
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
					if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.genos_2_evolved [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p1, p2, p3) -- name: setup
		local v4 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
		game:GetService("CollectionService")
		local v5 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.genos_2_evolved.arm_particles
		if p3 and p3.shiny then
			v5 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.genos_2_evolved.arm_particles_shiny
		end
		for _, v6 in pairs({ p1.arms.left["Plane.029"], p1.arms.right["Plane.047"] }) do
			for _, v7 in pairs(v5:GetChildren()) do
				v7:Clone().Parent = v6
			end
		end
		local v8 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.genos_2_evolved.RealisticSmoke
		for _, v9 in pairs({
			p1.Head,
			p1.Torso,
			p1["Left Arm"],
			p1["Right Arm"],
			p1["Left Leg"],
			p1["Right Leg"]
		}) do
			v8:Clone().Parent = v9
		end
		local v10 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.genos_2_evolved.PointLight
		if p3 and p3.shiny then
			v10 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.genos_2_evolved.PointLightShiny
		end
		v10:Clone().Parent = p1.Torso
		local v11 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.genos_2_evolved.eyes:Clone()
		v11.Parent = p1
		v4.weld(v11.PrimaryPart, p1.fakehead, v11.PrimaryPart, CFrame.new(-0.00866699219, 0.0506521463, -0.213645935, 0.999850512, 0.010747605, 0.0135717979, -0.0107485866, 0.999942243, -1.07196206e-6, -0.0135710314, -0.000144805701, 0.999908268))
		local v12 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.genos_2_evolved.eye_att_ref
		for _, v13 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
			v13:Clone().Parent = p1.fakehead
		end
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.itachi_2_evolved [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, _, p_u_2) -- name: setup
		require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_2
			if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					return
				end
			end
			local v_u_3 = p_u_1.Head
			local v_u_4 = p_u_1.fakehead
			p_u_1 = nil
			v_u_4.Decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://86759266143164"
			v_u_4.Decal.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(600, 255, 255)
			local v5 = v_u_4.Decal:Clone()
			v5.Name = "eyes"
			v5.Texture = "rbxassetid://134140426034362"
			v5.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(1000, 255, 255)
			v5.Parent = v_u_4
			v_u_4.Parent = workspace.ignore
			if p_u_2 and p_u_2.is_actual_pet then
				game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_4, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_2.uuid)
			end
			local v_u_6 = nil
			v_u_6 = v_u_3.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_6
				if not v_u_3:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					if v_u_4 then
						v_u_4:Destroy()
						v_u_4 = nil
					end
					v_u_3 = nil
					v_u_6:Disconnect()
					v_u_6 = nil
				end
			end)
			v_u_3:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_3
				if v_u_4 then
					v_u_4.Size = Vector3.new(0.524, 0.519, 0.518) * (v_u_3.Size.Y / 0.432)
				end
			end)
			v_u_4.Size = Vector3.new(0.524, 0.519, 0.518) * (v_u_3.Size.Y / 0.432)
		end)
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.escanor [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, _, p_u_2) -- name: setup
		if not p_u_2.shiny then
			require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_2
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
					if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						return
					end
				end
				local v_u_3 = p_u_1.Head
				local v_u_4 = p_u_1.fakehead
				v_u_4.Parent = workspace.ignore
				if p_u_2 and p_u_2.is_actual_pet then
					game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_4, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_2.uuid)
				end
				local v_u_5 = nil
				v_u_5 = v_u_3.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
					if not v_u_3:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						if v_u_4 then
							v_u_4:Destroy()
							v_u_4 = nil
						end
						v_u_3 = nil
						v_u_5:Disconnect()
						v_u_5 = nil
					end
				end)
				local v_u_6 = v_u_4.Size
				local v_u_7 = v_u_3.Size
				v_u_3:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_3
					if v_u_4 then
						v_u_4.Size = v_u_6 * v_u_7.Z / v_u_3.Size.Z
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.fugo_evolved [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p1, p2, p3) -- name: setup
		require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
		local v4 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.fugo_evolved
		if p3 and p3.stand then
			for _, v5 in pairs({
				"StandHead",
				"Right Arm",
				"Right Leg",
				"Left Arm",
				"Left Leg"
			}) do
				local v6 = v4[v5]
				for _, v7 in pairs(v6:GetChildren()) do
					if not (v7:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or (v7:IsA("Attachment") or (v7:IsA("Beam") or (v7:IsA("Trail") or v7:IsA("PointLight"))))) then
						continue
					end
					if v5 == "StandHead" then
						v7:Clone().Parent = p1.Head
					else
						v7:Clone().Parent = p1[v5]
					end
				end
			end
		else
			for _, v8 in pairs({
				"Head",
				"Right Arm",
				"Right Leg",
				"Left Arm",
				"Left Leg"
			}) do
				local v9 = v4[v8]
				for _, v10 in pairs(v9:GetChildren()) do
					if not (v10:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or (v10:IsA("Attachment") or (v10:IsA("Beam") or (v10:IsA("Trail") or v10:IsA("PointLight"))))) then
						continue
					end
					v10:Clone().Parent = p1[v8]
				end
			end
		end
	end
}

return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, _, p_u_2) -- name: setup
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_2
			if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					return
				end
			end
			local v_u_3 = p_u_1.EndeavorNeon
			if p_u_2 and p_u_2.is_actual_pet then
				game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_3, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_2.uuid)
			end
			v_u_3.Parent = workspace.ignore
			local v_u_4 = p_u_1.HumanoidRootPart
			local v_u_5 = nil
			v_u_5 = v_u_4.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_5
				if not v_u_4:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					if v_u_3 then
						v_u_3:Destroy()
						v_u_3 = nil
					end
					v_u_4 = nil
					v_u_5:Disconnect()
					v_u_5 = nil
				end
			end)
			local v_u_6 = v_u_4
			for _, v_u_7 in pairs(v_u_3:GetChildren()) do
				local v_u_8 = v_u_7.Mesh.Scale
				v_u_7.Mesh.Scale = v_u_8 * v_u_6.Size.Z / 0.432
				v_u_6:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_6
					if v_u_7 then
						v_u_7.Mesh.Scale = v_u_8 * v_u_6.Size.Z / 0.432
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
}

return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, p2, p_u_3) -- name: setup
		require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
		local v_u_4 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.hoshino_evolved
		for _, v5 in pairs(v_u_4.Folder:GetChildren()) do
			for _, v6 in pairs(v5:GetChildren()) do
				v6:Clone().Parent = p_u_1[v5.Name]
			end
		end
		local v7 = v_u_4.Parts:Clone()
		v7.Parent = p_u_1
		for _, v8 in pairs(v7:GetChildren()) do
			v8.Weld.Part0 = p_u_1.Torso
		end
		local v_u_9 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_9
			if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					return
				end
			end
			local v_u_10
			if p_u_3 and p_u_3.shiny then
				v_u_10 = v_u_4.fakehead_shiny:Clone()
			else
				v_u_10 = v_u_4.fakehead:Clone()
			end
			local v_u_11 = p_u_1.fakehead
			p_u_1 = nil
			v_u_10.Parent = workspace.ignore
			v_u_9.weld(v_u_10, v_u_10, v_u_11)
			if p_u_3 and p_u_3.is_actual_pet then
				game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_10, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_3.uuid)
			end
			local v_u_12 = nil
			v_u_12 = v_u_11.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_12
				if not v_u_11:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10:Destroy()
						v_u_10 = nil
					end
					v_u_11 = nil
					v_u_12:Disconnect()
					v_u_12 = nil
				end
			end)
			local function v14() -- name: _on_size_changed
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_11
				if v_u_10 then
					v_u_10.Size = v_u_11.Size
					for _, v13 in pairs(v_u_10:GetChildren()) do
						if not v13:IsA("Attachment") then
							continue
						end
						if v13.Name == "AttachmentL" then
							v13.Position = Vector3.new(-0.1, 0.03, -0.247) * (v_u_11.Size.X / 0.524)
						else
							if v13.Name ~= "AttachmentR" then
								continue
							end
							v13.Position = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.03, -0.247) * (v_u_11.Size.X / 0.524)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			v_u_11:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(v14)
			v14()
		end)
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.madoka [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, p2, p_u_3) -- name: setup
		if p_u_3 and p_u_3.shiny then
			local v_u_4 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
			local v_u_5 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.madoka_evolved
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_3, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_4
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
					if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						return
					end
				end
				local v_u_6
				if p_u_3 and p_u_3.shiny then
					v_u_6 = v_u_5.fakehead:Clone()
				else
					v_u_6 = nil
				end
				local v_u_7 = p_u_1.fakehead
				p_u_1 = nil
				v_u_6.Parent = workspace.ignore
				v_u_4.weld(v_u_6, v_u_6, v_u_7)
				if p_u_3 and p_u_3.is_actual_pet then
					game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_6, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_3.uuid)
				end
				local v_u_8 = nil
				v_u_8 = v_u_7.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_8
					if not v_u_7:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						if v_u_6 then
							v_u_6:Destroy()
							v_u_6 = nil
						end
						v_u_7 = nil
						v_u_8:Disconnect()
						v_u_8 = nil
					end
				end)
				v_u_7:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function() -- name: _on_size_changed
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_7
					if v_u_6 then
						v_u_6.Size = v_u_7.Size
					end
				end)
				if v_u_6 then
					v_u_6.Size = v_u_7.Size
				end
			end)
		end
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.endeavor_evolved [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, p2, p_u_3) -- name: setup
		local v4
		if p_u_3 then
			v4 = p_u_3.shiny
		else
			v4 = p_u_3
		end
		local v5
		if v4 then
			v5 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.endeavor.shiny
		else
			v5 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.endeavor.normal
		end
		local v6 = v5.Head:Clone()
		for _, v7 in pairs(v6:GetChildren()) do
			v7.Parent = p_u_1.Head
		end
		v6:Destroy()
		for _, v8 in pairs({ p_u_1["Left Leg"], p_u_1["Right Leg"] }) do
			for _, v9 in pairs(v5.leg:GetChildren()) do
				v9:Clone().Parent = v8
			end
		end
		v5.torso.ParticleEmitter:Clone().Parent = p_u_1.Torso
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_3
			if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					return
				end
			end
			local v_u_10 = p_u_1.EndeavorNeon
			if p_u_3 and p_u_3.is_actual_pet then
				game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_10, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_3.uuid)
			end
			v_u_10.Parent = workspace.ignore
			local v_u_11 = p_u_1.HumanoidRootPart
			local v_u_12 = nil
			v_u_12 = v_u_11.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_12
				if not v_u_11:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10:Destroy()
						v_u_10 = nil
					end
					v_u_11 = nil
					v_u_12:Disconnect()
					v_u_12 = nil
				end
			end)
			local v_u_13 = v_u_11
			for _, v_u_14 in pairs(v_u_10:GetChildren()) do
				local v_u_15 = v_u_14.Mesh.Scale
				v_u_14.Mesh.Scale = v_u_15 * v_u_13.Size.Z / 0.432
				v_u_13:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_13
					if v_u_14 then
						v_u_14.Mesh.Scale = v_u_15 * v_u_13.Size.Z / 0.432
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
}

					continue
				end
				v10:Clone().Parent = p1.Torso
			end
			local v11 = v5.root_particles:Clone()
			v11.Parent = p1
			v4.weld(v11, p1.HumanoidRootPart, v11, CFrame.new(-0.037979126, -0.826661825, 0.0232467651, 1, -7.62356342e-20, 0, -7.62356342e-20, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1))
		end
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.madara_evolved [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, _, p_u_2) -- name: setup
		if not p_u_2.shiny then
			require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_2
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
					if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						return
					end
				end
				local v_u_3 = p_u_1.Head
				local v_u_4 = p_u_1.fakehead
				v_u_4.face.Texture = ""
				v_u_4.face.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(1000, 500, 500)
				v_u_4.Parent = workspace.ignore
				if p_u_2 and p_u_2.is_actual_pet then
					game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_4, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_2.uuid)
				end
				local v_u_5 = nil
				v_u_5 = v_u_3.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
					if not v_u_3:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						if v_u_4 then
							v_u_4:Destroy()
							v_u_4 = nil
						end
						v_u_3 = nil
						v_u_5:Disconnect()
						v_u_5 = nil
					end
				end)
				local v_u_6 = v_u_4.Size
				local v_u_7 = v_u_3.Size
				v_u_3:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_3
					if v_u_4 then
						v_u_4.Size = v_u_6 * v_u_7.Z / v_u_3.Size.Z
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.illya_evolved [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, p_u_2, p_u_3) -- name: setup
		if p_u_3 and (p_u_3.is_spawned_unit or p_u_3.from_placement) then
			local v4 = p_u_2.get_assets_path().particles.illya_evolved.human
			for _, v5 in pairs({
				"Right Arm",
				"Right Leg",
				"Left Arm",
				"Left Leg",
				"Head"
			}) do
				for _, v6 in pairs(v4:GetChildren()) do
					v6:Clone().Parent = p_u_1[v5]
				end
			end
		else
			local v7 = p_u_2.get_assets_path().particles.illya_evolved.berserker
			for _, v8 in pairs({
				"Right Arm",
				"Right Leg",
				"Left Arm",
				"Left Leg",
				"Head"
			}) do
				for _, v9 in pairs(v7:GetChildren()) do
					v9:Clone().Parent = p_u_1[v8]
				end
			end
			local v10 = p_u_2.get_assets_path().particles.illya_evolved.head
			for _, v11 in pairs({ "Head" }) do
				for _, v12 in pairs(v10:GetChildren()) do
					v12:Clone().Parent = p_u_1[v11]
				end
			end
			local v13 = p_u_2.get_assets_path().particles.illya_evolved.axe
			for _, v14 in pairs(p_u_1.beraxe:GetChildren()) do
				if not v14:IsA("BasePart") or v14.Name ~= "Part" then
					continue
				end
				for _, v15 in pairs(v13:GetChildren()) do
					v15:Clone().Parent = v14
				end
			end

				require(game.ReplicatedStorage.src.Util)
				local v16 = p_u_2.load_core_service(script, "UnitServiceCore")
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
					if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						return
					end
				end
				local v_u_17 = p_u_1.illya
				v_u_17.Parent = workspace.ignore
				local v18 = p_u_2.get_assets_path().particles.illya_evolved.human
				for _, v19 in pairs({
					"Right Arm",
					"Right Leg",
					"Left Arm",
					"Left Leg",
					"Head"
				}) do
					for _, v20 in pairs(v18:GetChildren()) do
						v20:Clone().Parent = v_u_17[v19]
					end
				end
				v_u_17.Humanoid.Animator:LoadAnimation(v16.get_animation_instance_from_id("rbxassetid://89207288009581")):Play()
				if p_u_3 and p_u_3.is_actual_pet then
					game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_17, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_3.uuid)
				end
				local v_u_21 = nil
				v_u_21 = p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_1, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_21
					if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then

							v_u_17:Destroy()
							v_u_17 = nil
						end
						p_u_1 = nil
						v_u_21:Disconnect()
						v_u_21 = nil
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end

return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, p2, p_u_3) -- name: setup

		end

		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_3
			if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					return
				end
			end

			local v_u_11 = p_u_1.fakehead

			if p_u_3 and p_u_3.is_actual_pet then

			end
			local v_u_12 = nil
			v_u_12 = v_u_10.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_12

					if v_u_11 then

						v_u_11 = nil
					end
					v_u_10 = nil
					v_u_12:Disconnect()
					v_u_12 = nil
				end
			end)
			v_u_11.Size = v_u_10.Size.Z / 0.432 * Vector3.new(0.524, 0.519, 0.518)

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_10

				}) do

							v9.LockedToPart = true
						end

					end
				end

					continue
				end

					end

					end

			end
		end

			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_3

				game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_13, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_3.uuid)
			end
			v_u_13.Parent = workspace.ignore
			local v_u_14 = p_u_1.Torso
			p_u_1 = nil
			local v_u_15 = nil
			v_u_15 = v_u_14.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_15
				if not v_u_14:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					if v_u_13 then
						v_u_13:Destroy()
						v_u_13 = nil
					end
					v_u_14 = nil

				end
			end)
			v_u_13:ScaleTo(v_u_14.Size.Z / 0.432)
			v_u_14:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_14
				if v_u_13 then
					v_u_13:ScaleTo(v_u_14.Size.Z / 0.432)
				end
			end)
			if p_u_3 and p_u_3.shiny then
				for _, v16 in pairs({ v_u_13.TorsoNeon, v_u_13.hair }) do
					for _, v17 in pairs(v16:GetChildren()) do
						if not v17:IsA("Texture") then
							continue
						end
						if v17.Face == Enum.NormalId.Front then
							v17:SetAttribute("_textureuspeed", 0.3333333333333333)
						else
							v17:SetAttribute("_textureuspeed", -0.3333333333333333)
						end
						v17:SetAttribute("_texturevspeed", 0.3333333333333333)
						game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v17, "_skin_textureuv_instances")
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
}

				end
			end
			v5:Destroy()
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1

				p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					return
				end
			end
			local v_u_7 = p_u_1.Head
			local v_u_8 = p_u_1.fakehead
			v_u_8.Parent = workspace.ignore
			if unit_mods and unit_mods.is_actual_pet then
				game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_8, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. unit_mods.uuid)
			end
			local v_u_9 = nil
			v_u_9 = v_u_7.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_9
				if not v_u_7:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					if v_u_8 then
						v_u_8:Destroy()
						v_u_8 = nil
					end
					v_u_7 = nil
					v_u_9:Disconnect()
					v_u_9 = nil
				end
			end)
			local v_u_10 = v_u_8.Size
			local v_u_11 = v_u_7.Size
			v_u_7:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_7

			end)
		end)

			for _, v20 in pairs({ "staff" }) do
				for _, v21 in pairs(v19.particles:GetChildren()) do
					if not v21:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
						continue
					end
					v21:Clone().Parent = p_u_1.staff[v20]
				end
			end
			v19.weapontip.Part.Attachment:Clone().Parent = p_u_1.staff.staff
		end
		local v22
		if p_u_3 and p_u_3.shiny then
			v22 = p_u_1.scythe.main
		else
			v22 = p_u_1.staff.staff
		end
		local v23
		if p_u_3 and p_u_3.shiny then
			v23 = v5.beamsShiny:Clone()
		else
			v23 = v5.beams:Clone()
		end
		for _, v24 in pairs(v23:GetChildren()) do
			v24:Clone().Parent = v22
		end
		v23:Destroy()
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.giselle [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, p2, p_u_3) -- name: setup
		local v4 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.giselle
		for _, v5 in pairs({
			"Right Arm",
			"Left Arm",
			"Right Leg",
			"Left Leg",
			"Head"
		}) do
			local v6 = v4.rest
			for _, v7 in pairs(v6:GetChildren()) do
				if not (v7:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or (v7:IsA("Attachment") or (v7:IsA("Beam") or (v7:IsA("Trail") or v7:IsA("PointLight"))))) then
					continue
				end
				v7:Clone().Parent = p_u_1[v5]
			end
		end
		for _, v8 in pairs({ "Torso" }) do
			local v9 = v4.torso
			for _, v10 in pairs(v9:GetChildren()) do
				if not (v10:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or (v10:IsA("Attachment") or (v10:IsA("Beam") or (v10:IsA("Trail") or v10:IsA("PointLight"))))) then
					continue
				end
				v10:Clone().Parent = p_u_1[v8]
			end
		end
		for _, v11 in pairs({ "Cube.007" }) do
			local v12 = v4["Cube.007"]
			for _, v13 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
				if not (v13:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or (v13:IsA("Attachment") or (v13:IsA("Beam") or (v13:IsA("Trail") or v13:IsA("PointLight"))))) then
					continue
				end
				v13:Clone().Parent = p_u_1["gissele-model"][v11]
			end
		end
		local v14 = v4["gissele-rig-ref"]:Clone()
		for _, v15 in pairs(v14:GetDescendants()) do
			if not (v15:IsA("Attachment") or v15:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and v15.Parent:IsA("Bone")) then
				continue
			end
			local v16 = v15.Parent.Name
			v15.Parent = p_u_1["gissele-rig"]:FindFirstChild(v16, true)
		end
		v14:Destroy()
		if p_u_3 and p_u_3.shiny then
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_3
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
					if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						return
					end
				end
				local v_u_17 = p_u_1.fakehead
				local v_u_18 = p_u_1.Head
				p_u_1 = nil
				v_u_17.Parent = workspace.ignore
				if p_u_3 and p_u_3.is_actual_pet then
					game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_17, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_3.uuid)
				end
				local v_u_19 = nil
				v_u_19 = v_u_18.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_19
					if not v_u_18:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						if v_u_17 then
							v_u_17:Destroy()
							v_u_17 = nil
						end
						v_u_18 = nil
						v_u_19:Disconnect()
						v_u_19 = nil
					end
				end)
				v_u_18:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function() -- name: _on_size_changed
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18
					if v_u_17 then
						v_u_17.Size = Vector3.new(0.524, 0.519, 0.518) * (v_u_18.Size.Z / 0.432)
					end
				end)
				if v_u_17 then
					v_u_17.Size = Vector3.new(0.524, 0.519, 0.518) * (v_u_18.Size.Z / 0.432)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
}

local function v_u_26(p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7) -- name: add_spin
	if p3 then
		local v8 = {}
		for _, v9 in ipairs(p3:GetDescendants()) do
			if not v9:IsA("BasePart") then
				continue
			end
			v8[v9] = true
		end
		local v10 = {}
		local v11 = nil
		for _, v12 in ipairs(p2:GetDescendants()) do
			if not (v12:IsA("JointInstance") or v12:IsA("WeldConstraint")) or (not v12.Part0 or (not v12.Part1 or v8[v12.Part0] == v8[v12.Part1])) then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(v10, v12)
			v11 = v11 or v8[v12.Part0] and v12.Part1 or v12.Part0
		end
		if v11 then
			local v13 = CFrame.new(p3:GetBoundingBox().Position) * ((p4 or v11).CFrame * p5).Rotation
			local v14 = p7 .. "_base"
			local v15 = Instance.new("Part")
			v15.Name = v14
			v15.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
			v15.CFrame = v13
			v15.Transparency = 1
			v15.Anchored = false
			v15.CanCollide = false
			v15.CanQuery = false
			v15.CanTouch = false
			v15.CastShadow = false
			v15.Massless = true
			v15.Parent = p3
			local v16 = p7 .. "_part"
			local v17 = Instance.new("Part")
			v17.Name = v16
			v17.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
			v17.CFrame = v13
			v17.Transparency = 1
			v17.Anchored = false
			v17.CanCollide = false
			v17.CanQuery = false
			v17.CanTouch = false
			v17.CastShadow = false
			v17.Massless = true
			v17.Parent = p3
			local v18 = Instance.new("Weld")
			local v19 = p7 .. "_weld"
			local v20 = v11.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(v13)
			v18.Name = v19
			v18.Part0 = v11
			v18.Part1 = v15
			v18.C0 = v20
			v18.Parent = v15
			local v21 = Instance.new("Motor6D")
			v21.Name = p7 .. "_motor"
			v21.Part0 = v15
			v21.Part1 = v17
			v21.MaxVelocity = p6
			v21.DesiredAngle = 9.99999984e17
			v21.Parent = v15
			for _, v22 in ipairs(v10) do
				local v23 = v8[v22.Part0] and v22.Part0 or v22.Part1
				if v22:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
					if v22.Part0 == v23 then
						v22.Part1 = v17
					else
						v22.Part0 = v17
					end
				else
					local v24 = v17.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(v23.CFrame)
					local v25 = CFrame.new()
					v22.Part0 = v17
					v22.Part1 = v23
					v22.C0 = v24
					v22.C1 = v25
				end
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.megumin_evolved [ModuleScript]
return {
	["setup"] = function(p_u_1, p2, p_u_3) -- name: setup
		local v4 = p2.get_assets_path().particles.megumin
		for _, v5 in pairs(v4:GetChildren()) do
			local v6 = v5:Clone()
			if v6.Name == "Orb" then
				for _, v7 in pairs(v6:GetChildren()) do
					v7.Parent = p_u_1.Staff.Orb
				end
				v6:Destroy()
			else
				for _, v8 in pairs(v6:GetChildren()) do
					v8.Parent = p_u_1[v6.Name]
				end
				v6:Destroy()
			end
		end
		p_u_1.Staff.Orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		p_u_1.Staff.Orb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 47, 47)
		for _, v9 in pairs(p_u_1.fakehead:GetChildren()) do
			if v9.Name == "face1" then
				v9.Transparency = 1
			else
				if v9.Name ~= "face2" then
					continue
				end
				v9.Transparency = 0
			end
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_1, (copy) p_u_3
			if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
				if not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					return
				end
			end
			local v_u_10 = p_u_1.fakehead
			local v_u_11 = p_u_1.Head
			p_u_1 = nil
			v_u_10.Parent = workspace.ignore
			if p_u_3 and p_u_3.is_actual_pet then
				game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(v_u_10, "pet_outside_accessories:" .. p_u_3.uuid)
			end
			local v_u_12 = nil
			v_u_12 = v_u_11.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_12
				if not v_u_11:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10:Destroy()
						v_u_10 = nil
					end
					v_u_11 = nil
					v_u_12:Disconnect()
					v_u_12 = nil
				end
			end)
			v_u_11:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function() -- name: _on_size_changed
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_11
				if v_u_10 then
					v_u_10.Size = Vector3.new(0.524, 0.519, 0.518) * (v_u_11.Size.Z / 0.432)
				end
			end)
			if v_u_10 then
				v_u_10.Size = Vector3.new(0.524, 0.519, 0.518) * (v_u_11.Size.Z / 0.432)
			end
		end)
		if p_u_3 and p_u_3.shiny then
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_1
				while not p_u_1:IsDescendantOf(game) do
					p_u_1.AncestryChanged:Wait()
				end
				p_u_1.tail.AnimationController.Animator:LoadAnimation(p_u_1.tail.Animation):Play()
			end)
		end
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.core.Services.UnitScriptsShared.SetupScripts.mitsuri_evolved [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
local v_u_2 = {
	["ParticleEmitter"] = true,
	["Trail"] = true,
	["Beam"] = true,
	["PointLight"] = true,
	["SpotLight"] = true
}
function v1.setup(p3, p4, _) -- name: setup
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v5 = p4.load_core_service(script, "UnitServiceCore").get_setup_particles("mitsuri")
	if v5 then
		for _, v6 in pairs(v5:GetChildren()) do
			local v7 = p3:FindFirstChild(v6.Name)
			if not (v6:IsA("BasePart") and v7) then
				continue
			end
			for _, v8 in pairs(v6:GetChildren()) do
				if not v_u_2[v8.ClassName] then
					continue
				end
				v8:Clone().Parent = v7
			end
		end
		local v9 = v5:FindFirstChild("aa_mitsuri_sword")
		local v10 = p3:FindFirstChild("aa_mitsuri_sword")
		if v9 and v10 then
			for _, v11 in pairs(v9:GetDescendants()) do
				if not v_u_2[v11.ClassName] then
					continue
				end
				local v12 = v11.Parent.Name
				local v13
				if v12 == v10.Name then
					v13 = v10
				else
					v13 = v10:FindFirstChild(v12, true)
				end
				if not v13 then
					continue
				end
				local v14 = v11:Clone()
				if v14:IsA("Trail") or v14:IsA("Beam") then
					local v15 = v11.Attachment0
					if v15 then
						local v16 = v11.Attachment0.Name
						if v16 == v10.Name then
							v15 = v10
						else
							v15 = v10:FindFirstChild(v16, true)
						end
					end
					v14.Attachment0 = v15
					local v17 = v11.Attachment1
					if v17 then
						local v18 = v11.Attachment1.Name
						if v18 == v10.Name then
							v17 = v10
						else
							v17 = v10:FindFirstChild(v18, true)
						end
					end
					v14.Attachment1 = v17
				end
				v14.Parent = v13
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
return v1

local function v53(p33, p34) -- name: make_waves
	local v35 = {}
	for v36 = 1, p33 do
		local v37 = {}
		local v38 = v36 + 4
		if v38 > 0 then
			table.insert(v37, {
				["unit"] = "lesser",
				["amount"] = nil,
				["amount"] = v38
			})
		end
		local v39
		if v36 >= 2 then
			local v40 = v36 * 0.6
			v39 = math.floor(v40) or 0
		else
			v39 = 0
		end
		if v39 > 0 then
			table.insert(v37, {
				["unit"] = "swift",
				["amount"] = nil,
				["amount"] = v39
			})
		end

		if v36 >= 3 then
			local v42 = v36 / 2
			v41 = math.floor(v42) or 0
		else
			v41 = 0
		end
		if v41 > 0 then
			table.insert(v37, {
				["unit"] = "spawn",
				["amount"] = nil,
				["amount"] = v41
			})
		end
		local v43
		if v36 % 4 == 0 then
			local v44 = v36 / 12
			v43 = math.floor(v44) + 1 or 0
		else
			v43 = 0
		end
		if v43 > 0 then
			table.insert(v37, {
				["unit"] = "cowering",
				["amount"] = nil,
				["amount"] = v43
			})
		end
		local v45
		if v36 >= 6 and v36 % 3 == 0 then
			local v46 = v36 / 12
			v45 = math.floor(v46) + 1 or 0
		else
			v45 = 0
		end
		if v45 > 0 then
			table.insert(v37, {
				["unit"] = "winged",
				["amount"] = nil,
				["amount"] = v45
			})
		end

		if v36 >= 10 and v36 % 3 == 1 then
			local v48 = (v36 - 10) / 6
			v47 = math.floor(v48) + 1 or 0
		else
			v47 = 0
		end
		if v47 > 0 then
			table.insert(v37, {
				["unit"] = "pot",

			})
		end
		local v49
		if v36 >= 12 and v36 % 4 == 0 then

		end

		end

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.Data.Units [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
for _, v2 in pairs(script:GetDescendants()) do
	if not v2:IsA("ModuleScript") or v2.Name == "UnitPresets" then
		continue
	end
	for v3, v4 in pairs(require(v2)) do
		v1[v3] = v4
	end
end
return v1

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.Data.CSMEventData [ModuleScript]
local v_u_5 = {
	["_get_bullets_required"] = function(p1)
		return p1 == 0 and 0 or (p1 == 1 and 10 or (p1 == 2 and 30 or (p1 == 3 and 75 or (p1 == 4 and 135 or 235))))
	end,
	["_get_rank"] = function(p2)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
		local v3 = 0
		for v4 = 0, 5 do
			if p2 < v_u_5._get_bullets_required(v4) then
				return v3
			end
			v3 = v4
		end
		return v3
	end
}
return v_u_5

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.Data.Worlds [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
for _, v2 in pairs(script:GetDescendants()) do
	if not v2:IsA("ModuleScript") or v2.Name == "UnitPresets" then
		continue
	end
	for v3, v4 in pairs(require(v2)) do
		v1[v3] = v4
	end
end
return v1

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.Data.Items [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
for _, v2 in pairs(script:GetDescendants()) do
	if not v2:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		continue
	end
	for v3, v4 in pairs(require(v2)) do
		v1[v3] = v4
	end
end
return v1

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.Data.Quests [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
for _, v2 in pairs(script:GetDescendants()) do
	if not v2:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		continue
	end
	for v3, v4 in pairs(require(v2)) do
		v1[v3] = v4
	end
end
return v1

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.Data.QuestsEvent [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
for _, v2 in pairs(script:GetDescendants()) do
	if not v2:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		continue
	end
	for v3, v4 in pairs(require(v2)) do
		v1[v3] = v4
	end
end
return v1

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.Data.LeaderboardRewards [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
for _, v2 in pairs(script:GetDescendants()) do
	if not v2:IsA("ModuleScript") or v2.Name == "UnitPresets" then
		continue
	end
	for v3, v4 in pairs(require(v2)) do
		v1[v3] = v4
	end
end
return v1

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.Data.Blessings [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
for _, v2 in pairs(script:GetDescendants()) do
	if not v2:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		continue
	end
	for v3, v4 in pairs(require(v2)) do
		v1[v3] = v4
	end
end
return v1

local v1 = {}
for _, v2 in pairs(script:GetDescendants()) do
	if not v2:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		continue
	end
	for v3, v4 in pairs(require(v2)) do
		v1[v3] = v4
	end
end
return v1

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.Data.Titles [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
for _, v2 in pairs(script:GetDescendants()) do
	if not v2:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		continue
	end
	for v3, v4 in pairs(require(v2)) do
		v1[v3] = v4
	end
end
return v1

-- ReplicatedStorage.src.Data.Emotes [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
for _, v2 in pairs(script:GetDescendants()) do
	if not v2:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		continue
	end
	for v3, v4 in pairs(require(v2)) do
		v1[v3] = v4
	end
end
return v1

return function(p1, p2)

		local v4 = nil
		local v5 = nil
		if p1.ClassName == "Model" and p1.PrimaryPart then
			v4 = p1.PrimaryPart
			v5 = v4.CFrame

		end

				else

				v6.Position = v6.Position * p2

				v6.C0 = v6.C0 + v6.C0.Position * (p2 - 1)
				v6.C1 = v6.C1 + v6.C1.Position * (p2 - 1)
			else

				end

				v6.CurveSize1 = v6.CurveSize1 * p2

function B(p2, p3, p4) -- name: B
	local function v_u_6(p5) -- name: fact
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
		return p5 == 0 and 1 or p5 * v_u_6(p5 - 1)
	end

	local v9 = p2 - p3

function v_u_1.new(...) -- name: new

function v_u_1.AddBezierPoint(p_u_13, p14, p15) -- name: AddBezierPoint

		local v_u_16 = {
			["Type"] = typeof(p14) == "Vector3" and "StaicPoint" or "BasePartPoint",

				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_13

				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_13, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_18

					if v20 then
						table.remove(p_u_13.Points, v20)

			end)

			end

			table.insert(v22, v23)

		end

			table.insert(v25, p15, v_u_16)
		elseif p15 then
			if type(p15) ~= "number" then
				error("Bezier:AddBezierPoint() only accepts an integer as the second argument!")
			end
		else
			local v26 = p_u_13.Points
			table.insert(v26, v_u_16)
		end
		p_u_13:UpdateLength()
	else

	end
end

	end
end

function v8.Format(p28, p29) -- name: Format
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_6
	v_u_1.class.try_coerce(1, p28, "NumberFormatter")
	if type(p29) == "string" then
		error("Argument #2 as a string interpreted as decimal is not currently supported, please cast the argument to a double if you want the string to be interpreted as a double", 2)
	end
	local v30 = v_u_1.class.try_coerce(2, p29, "number")
	local v31 = v_u_1.class.get_resolved_data(p28, v_u_27)
	local v32 = v31.symbols
	local v33, v34, v35
	if v30 == v30 then
		if v30 == (1 / 0) or v30 == (-1 / 0) then
			v33 = v30 < 0
			v34 = v32[v_u_6.ENumberFormatSymbols.kInfinitySymbol]
			v35 = false
		else
			local v36, v37, v38
			if v30 == 0 then
				v33 = math.atan2(v30, -1) < 0
				v36 = nil
				v37 = 0
				v38 = 1
			else
				v33 = v30 < 0
				v36, v37, v38 = v_u_1.decimal_conversion.from_double((math.abs(v30)))
			end
			v34, v35 = v_u_1.format.format_unsigned_finite(v36, v37, v38, v33, v31)
		end
	else
		local v39 = string.pack
		v33 = string.byte(v39(">d", v30)) >= 128
		v34 = v32[v_u_6.ENumberFormatSymbols.kNaNSymbol]
		v35 = true
	end
	return v_u_1.format.display_sign(v34, v33, v35, v31.displaySignAt, v31.symbols)
end

local function v_u_43(p37) -- name: skeleton_to_scientific_notation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_1
	local v38, v40, v40 = string.match(p37, "^(%a+)/?([^/]*)/?([^/]*)$")
	local v41 = 1
	local v42 = v_u_2.SignDisplay.AUTO
	if v38 == "scientific" or v38 == "engineering" then
		if string.match(v40, "^[%*%+]e+$") then
			v41 = #v40 - 1
		elseif string.match(v40, "^[%*%+]e+$") then
			v41 = #v40 - 1
		end
		if v40 ~= "" then
			if string.sub(v40, 1, 5) ~= "sign-" then
				return nil
			end
			v42 = v_u_36[v40]
		end
		if v41 > 999 then
			return nil
		else
			return table.freeze({
				["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.NotationType.SCIENTIFIC,
				["power10Scale"] = v38 == "engineering" and 3 or 1,
				["minExponentDigits"] = v41,
				["exponentSignDisplay"] = v42,
				["displayExponentSignAt"] = v_u_1.generate_from_sign_enum(v42)
			})
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end
local function v_u_50(p44) -- name: skeleton_to_scientific_notation_concise

end
local function v_u_71(p51) -- name: skeleton_to_precision
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	local v52, v53, v54 = string.match(p51, "^%.((0*)#*)(.*)$")
	if not v52 then
		v52, v54 = string.match(p51, "^(precision%-integer)(.*)$")
	end
	if v52 then
		local v55, v56
		if v52 == "precision-integer" then
			v55 = 0
			v56 = 0
		else
			v55 = #v53
			v56 = #v52
		end
		if string.match(v54, "^[%*%+]") and v53 == v52 then
			v54 = string.sub(v54, 2)
			v56 = -1
		end
		if v55 > 999 or v56 > 999 then
			return nil
		else
			if v56 == -1 then
				v56 = v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION
			end
			if string.sub(v54, 1, 1) == "/" then
				local v57 = false
				local v58, v59, v60 = string.match(v54, "^/((@+)#*)([%*%+rs]?)$")
				if not v58 or v60 == "" and v59 ~= "@" or (v60 == "*" or v60 == "+") and v59 ~= v58 then
					return nil
				end
				local v61, v62
				if v60 == "" then
					v61 = #v58
					v62 = 1
					v60 = "s"
				elseif v60 == "*" or v60 == "+" then
					v61 = #v59
					v62 = 1
					v60 = "r"
				else
					v62 = #v59
					v61 = #v58
					v57 = true
				end
				if v62 > 999 or v61 > 999 then
					return nil
				end
				local v63 = table.freeze
				local v64 = {
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION_SIGNIFICANT,
					["minFractionDigits"] = v55,
					["maxFractionDigits"] = v56,
					["minSignificantDigits"] = v62,
					["maxSignificantDigits"] = v61
				}
				local v65
				if v60 == "r" then
					v65 = v_u_2.RoundingPriority.RELAXED
				else
					v65 = v_u_2.RoundingPriority.STRICT
				end
				v64.roundingPriority = v65
				v64.sourcedWithSignificantDigits = v57
				return v63(v64)
			elseif v54 == "" then
				return table.freeze({
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION,
					["min"] = v55,
					["max"] = v56
				})
			else
				return nil
			end
		end
	else
		local v66, v67, v68 = string.match(p51, "^((@+)#*)([%*%+]?)$")
		if not v66 then
			return nil
		end
		local v69 = #v67
		local v70 = #v66
		if v68 ~= "" then
			if v69 ~= v70 then
				return nil
			end
			string.sub(v68, 2)
			v70 = -1
		end
		if v69 > 999 or v70 > 999 then
			return nil
		end
		if v70 == -1 then
			v70 = v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION
		end
		return table.freeze({
			["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.SIGNFICANT,
			["min"] = v69,
			["max"] = v70
		})
	end
end
local function v_u_76(p72) -- name: skeleton_to_int_width
	if p72 == "integer-width-trunc" then
		return table.freeze({
			["min"] = 0,
			["max"] = 0
		})
	else
		local v73 = string.match(p72, "^integer%-width/[%*%+](0*)$")
		if v73 then
			if #v73 > 999 then
				return nil
			else
				return table.freeze({
					["min"] = nil,
					["max"] = -1,
					["min"] = #v73
				})
			end
		else
			local v74, v75 = string.match(p72, "^integer%-width/(#*(0*))$")
			if v74 and (v74 ~= "" and (#v74 <= 999 and #v75 <= 999)) then
				return table.freeze({
					["min"] = #v75,
					["max"] = #v74
				})
			else
				return nil
			end
		end
	end
end
local function v_u_78(p77) -- name: skeleton_to_int_width_concise
	if string.match(p77, "^0+$") and #p77 < 1000 then
		return table.freeze({
			["min"] = nil,
			["max"] = -1,
			["min"] = #p77
		})
	else
		return nil
	end
end
function v3.to_option_linked_list(p79) -- name: to_option_linked_list
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_35, (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_43, (copy) v_u_50, (copy) v_u_71, (copy) v_u_76, (copy) v_u_78
	local v80 = {}
	local v81 = nil
	for v82, v83 in string.gmatch(p79, "()(%S+)") do
		local v84 = v_u_35[v83]
		local v85
		if v84 then
			v85 = v_u_36[v83]
		else
			v85 = nil
		end
		if not v85 then
			v85 = v_u_43(v83) or v_u_50(v83)
			if v85 then
				v84 = "notation"
			end
		end
		if not v85 then
			v85 = v_u_71(v83)
			if v85 then
				v84 = "precision"
			end
		end
		if not v85 then
			v85 = v_u_76(v83) or v_u_78(v83)
			if v85 then
				v84 = "integerWidth"
			end
		end
		if not v84 or v80[v84] then
			return false, string.format("number skeleton syntax error near \'%*\' at position %d", string.gsub(v83, "\'", "\\\'"), v82)
		end
		v80[v84] = true
		v81 = {
			["key"] = v84,
			["value"] = v85,
			["parent"] = v81
		}
	end
	return true, v81
end
return v3

-- ReplicatedStorage.imported.FormatNumber.Version [ModuleScript]
local v1 = {}
local function v_u_3(p2) -- name: version_tostring
	return string.format("%d.%d", p2.Major, p2.Minor)
end
local function v_u_6(p4, p5) -- name: version_lt
	if p4.Major == p5.Major then
		return p4.Minor < p5.Minor
	else
		return p4.Major < p5.Major
	end
end
local function v_u_10(p7, p8) -- name: version_eq
	local v9
	if p7.Major == p8.Major then
		v9 = p7.Minor == p8.Minor
	else
		v9 = false
	end
	return v9
end
function v1.new(p11, p12) -- name: new
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_10
	local v13 = newproxy(true)
	local v14 = getmetatable(v13)
	local v15 = {}
	local v16 = tonumber(p11) or 0
	local v17
	if math.clamp(v16, -2147483648, 2147483647) == p11 then
		if p11 <= -1 then
			v17 = math.ceil(p11)
		else
			v17 = p11 < 1 and 0 or math.floor(p11)
		end
	else
		v17 = UDim.new(nil, p11).Offset
	end
	v15.Major = v17
	local v18 = tonumber(p12) or 0
	local v19
	if math.clamp(v18, -2147483648, 2147483647) == p12 then
		if p12 <= -1 then
			v19 = math.ceil(p12)
		else
			v19 = p12 < 1 and 0 or math.floor(p12)
		end
	else
		v19 = UDim.new(nil, p12).Offset
	end
	v15.Minor = v19
	v14.__index = v15
	v14.__metatable = "The metatable is locked"
	v14.__tostring = v_u_3
	v14.__lt = v_u_6
	v14.__eq = v_u_10
	table.freeze(v14)
	return v13
end
v1.current = v1.new(31, 1)

-- ReplicatedStorage._TheHatch.Client.GUIs.Tween [ModuleScript]
return function(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6)
	local v7 = p5 or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad
	local v8 = p6 or Enum.EasingDirection.Out
	local v9 = type(p3) == "table"
	local v10 = {}
	local v11 = p4 or 0.5
	for v12, v13 in pairs(p2) do
		local v14
		if v9 then
			v14 = p3[v12] or p3
		else
			v14 = p3
		end
		v10[v13] = v14
	end
	local v15 = TweenInfo.new(v11, v7, v8)
	local v16 = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(p1, v15, v10)
	v16:Play()
	return v16
end

-- ReplicatedStorage._TheHatch.Shared.Characters [ModuleScript]
local v_u_1 = game:GetService("CollectionService")
return {
	["getCharacterModel"] = function(p2) -- name: getCharacterModel
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		local v3 = v_u_1:GetTagged((("HatchCharacterOverride_%*"):format(p2.UserId)))
		if #v3 == 0 then
			return p2.Character
		end
		for _, v4 in v3 do
			if not v4:IsA("Model") then
				continue
			end
			return v4
		end
		return nil
	end
}

-- ReplicatedStorage._lobby_parked._map.deco_and_lights.Fish 1 [Loop].Rotate Script [Script]
local v1 = game:GetService("RunService")
local v_u_2 = script.Parent
if script:GetAttribute("Speed") == nil then
	script:SetAttribute("Speed", 20)
end
if script:GetAttribute("Axis") == nil then
	script:SetAttribute("Axis", Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
end
local v_u_3 = v_u_2:GetPivot()
local v_u_4 = 0
v1.Heartbeat:Connect(function(p5)
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3
	local v6 = script:GetAttribute("Speed") or 0
	local v7 = script:GetAttribute("Axis") or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	if v6 ~= 0 and v7.Magnitude ~= 0 then
		v_u_4 = (v_u_4 + math.rad(v6) * p5) % 6.283185307179586
		v_u_2:PivotTo(v_u_3 * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v7.Unit, v_u_4))
	end
end)

function v_u_1.handle_level_modifiers(p4, p5, p6) -- name: handle_level_modifiers
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	local v7
	if p4:FindFirstChild("List") then
		v7 = p4.List
	else
		v7 = p4
	end
	for _, v8 in pairs(v7:GetChildren()) do
		if not (v8:IsA("ImageLabel") or v8:IsA("Frame")) then
			continue
		end
		v8:Destroy()
	end
	if p5 then
		local v9 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Data"):WaitForChild("LevelModifiers"))
		local v10 = {}
		local v11 = {}
		for _, v12 in pairs(p5._levelmodifiers or {}) do
			local v13 = v9[v12.id]
			if not v13 then
				continue
			end
			local v14 = v12.id
			local v15
			if v13.buffed_version then
				v14 = v13.buffed_version.id
				v15 = v13.buffed_version.v
			else
				v15 = 1
			end
			local v16 = {
				["icon_id"] = v14,
				["v"] = v15,
				["title"] = v13.name,
				["text"] = v13.desc
			}
			table.insert(v10, v16)
			v11[v12.id] = true
		end
		local v17 = p5._challenge
		local v18
		if v17 then
			v18 = v9[v17] or v9[v_u_3[v17]]
		else
			v18 = v17
		end
		if v18 then
			v17 = v18.id
		end
		if v18 and not v11[v17] then
			local v19
			if v18.buffed_version then
				v17 = v18.buffed_version.id
				v19 = v18.buffed_version.v
			else
				v19 = 1
			end
			local v20 = {
				["icon_id"] = v17,
				["v"] = v19,
				["title"] = v18.name,
				["text"] = v18.desc
			}
			table.insert(v10, v20)
		end
		if #v10 ~= 0 then
			local v21 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("packages"):WaitForChild("assets"):WaitForChild("LevelModifiers")
			for _, v_u_22 in ipairs(v10) do
				if not v21:FindFirstChild(v_u_22.icon_id) then
					continue
				end
				local v23 = v21[v_u_22.icon_id]:Clone()
				v23.Parent = v7
				if v_u_22.v and v_u_22.v > 1 then
					local v24 = v21.TextLabel:Clone()
					local v25 = v_u_2
					local v26 = v_u_22.v
					v24.Text = v25[tostring(v26)]
					v24.Parent = v23.inner
				end
				if not p6 then
					continue
				end
				p6.hover_info_ui:track_hover(v23, function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_22
					return {
						["title"] = v_u_22.title,
						["text"] = v_u_22.text
					}
				end)
			end
			p4.Visible = true
			return true
		end
		p4.Visible = false
	else
		p4.Visible = false
	end
end

function v_u_1.tween_out(p_u_60) -- name: tween_out

		p_u_60:Destroy()
	end)
	v61:Play()
	TweenService:Create(p_u_60.iconandshadows.Wrapper.Shadow, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
		["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1
	}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(p_u_60.iconandshadows.Wrapper.Background, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
		["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1,
		["ImageTransparency"] = 1

		["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1,
		["ImageTransparency"] = 1
	}):Play()
	for _, v62 in pairs({
		p_u_60.Info.Info.Description,
		p_u_60.Info.Info.Label,
		p_u_60.Info.Info.Location,
		p_u_60.Info.Tip.Tip
	}) do

			["TextTransparency"] = 1
		}):Play()
	end

		TweenService:Create(v63.UIStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
			["Transparency"] = 1
		}):Play()
	end
	TweenService:Create(p_u_60.bg.LoadingInfo.Icon, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
		["ImageTransparency"] = 1
	}):Play()
end

		end)
	end

	v_u_33:ActivateOcclusionModule(v_u_4.LocalPlayer.DevCameraOcclusionMode)
	v_u_33:OnCurrentCameraChanged()
	v_u_5:BindToRenderStep("cameraRenderUpdate", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value, function(p39)

function v_u_1.GetCameraMovementModeFromSettings(_) -- name: GetCameraMovementModeFromSettings
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_8
	if v_u_4.LocalPlayer.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then
		return v_u_12.ConvertCameraModeEnumToStandard(Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic)
	else
		local v42, v43
		if v_u_6.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch then
			v42 = v_u_12.ConvertCameraModeEnumToStandard(v_u_4.LocalPlayer.DevTouchCameraMode)
			v43 = v_u_12.ConvertCameraModeEnumToStandard(v_u_8.TouchCameraMovementMode)
		else
			v42 = v_u_12.ConvertCameraModeEnumToStandard(v_u_4.LocalPlayer.DevComputerCameraMode)
			v43 = v_u_12.ConvertCameraModeEnumToStandard(v_u_8.ComputerCameraMovementMode)
		end
		if v42 == Enum.DevComputerCameraMovementMode.UserChoice then
			return v43
		else
			return v42
		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.ActivateOcclusionModule(p44, p45) -- name: ActivateOcclusionModule
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_4
	local v46
	if p45 == Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Zoom then
		v46 = v_u_21
	else
		if p45 ~= Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam then
			warn("CameraScript ActivateOcclusionModule called with unsupported mode")
			return
		end
		v46 = v_u_20
	end
	p44.occlusionMode = p45
	if p44.activeOcclusionModule and p44.activeOcclusionModule:GetOcclusionMode() == p45 then
		if not p44.activeOcclusionModule:GetEnabled() then
			p44.activeOcclusionModule:Enable(true)
		end
	else
		local v47 = p44.activeOcclusionModule
		p44.activeOcclusionModule = v_u_25[v46]
		if not p44.activeOcclusionModule then
			p44.activeOcclusionModule = v46.new()
			if p44.activeOcclusionModule then
				v_u_25[v46] = p44.activeOcclusionModule
			end
		end
		if p44.activeOcclusionModule then
			if p44.activeOcclusionModule:GetOcclusionMode() ~= p45 then
				warn("CameraScript ActivateOcclusionModule mismatch: ", p44.activeOcclusionModule:GetOcclusionMode(), "~=", p45)
			end
			if v47 then
				if v47 == p44.activeOcclusionModule then
					warn("CameraScript ActivateOcclusionModule failure to detect already running correct module")
				else
					v47:Enable(false)
				end
			end
			if p45 == Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam then
				if v_u_4.LocalPlayer.Character then
					p44.activeOcclusionModule:CharacterAdded(v_u_4.LocalPlayer.Character, v_u_4.LocalPlayer)
				end
			else
				for _, v48 in pairs(v_u_4:GetPlayers()) do
					if not (v48 and v48.Character) then
						continue
					end
					p44.activeOcclusionModule:CharacterAdded(v48.Character, v48)
				end
				p44.activeOcclusionModule:OnCameraSubjectChanged(game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject)
			end
			p44.activeOcclusionModule:Enable(true)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.ShouldUseVehicleCamera(p49) -- name: ShouldUseVehicleCamera
	local v50 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not v50 then
		return false
	end
	local v51 = v50.CameraType
	local v52 = v50.CameraSubject
	local v53 = v51 == Enum.CameraType.Custom and true or v51 == Enum.CameraType.Follow
	local v54 = v52 and v52:IsA("VehicleSeat") or false
	local v55 = p49.occlusionMode ~= Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam
	if v54 then
		if not v53 then
			v55 = v53
		end
	else
		v55 = v54
	end
	return v55
end
function v_u_1.ActivateCameraController(p56) -- name: ActivateCameraController
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_29
	local v57 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType
	local v58 = p56:GetCameraMovementModeFromSettings()
	local v59 = nil
	if v57 == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
		if p56.activeCameraController then
			p56.activeCameraController:Enable(false)
			p56.activeCameraController = nil
		end
	else
		if v57 == Enum.CameraType.Custom then
			v58 = p56:GetCameraMovementModeFromSettings()
		elseif v57 == Enum.CameraType.Track then
			v58 = Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic
		elseif v57 == Enum.CameraType.Follow then
			v58 = Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Follow
		elseif v57 == Enum.CameraType.Orbital then
			v58 = Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Orbital
		elseif v57 == Enum.CameraType.Attach or (v57 == Enum.CameraType.Watch or v57 == Enum.CameraType.Fixed) then
			v59 = v_u_16
		else
			warn("CameraScript encountered an unhandled Camera.CameraType value: ", v57)
		end
		if not v59 then
			if v_u_7.VREnabled then
				v59 = v_u_18
			elseif v58 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic or (v58 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Follow or (v58 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Default or v58 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.CameraToggle)) then
				v59 = v_u_14
			else
				if v58 ~= Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Orbital then
					warn("ActivateCameraController did not select a module.")
					return
				end
				v59 = v_u_15
			end
		end
		if p56:ShouldUseVehicleCamera() then
			if v_u_7.VREnabled then
				v59 = v_u_19
			else
				v59 = v_u_17
			end
		end
		local v60
		if v_u_24[v59] then
			v60 = v_u_24[v59]
			if v_u_29 then
				if v60.Reset and p56.activeCameraController ~= v60 then
					v60:Reset()
				end
			elseif v60.Reset then
				v60:Reset()
			end
		else
			v60 = v59.new()
			v_u_24[v59] = v60
		end
		if p56.activeCameraController then
			if p56.activeCameraController == v60 then
				if not p56.activeCameraController:GetEnabled() then
					p56.activeCameraController:Enable(true)
				end
			else
				if v60.HandleSubjectDistance then
					v60:HandleSubjectDistance(p56.activeCameraController)
				end
				p56.activeCameraController:Enable(false)
				p56.activeCameraController = v60
				p56.activeCameraController:Enable(true)
			end
		elseif v60 ~= nil then
			p56.activeCameraController = v60
			local v61 = p56.activeCameraController
			assert(v61, "Strict typing check")
			p56.activeCameraController:Enable(true)
		end
		if p56.activeCameraController then
			p56.activeCameraController:SetCameraMovementMode(v58)
			p56.activeCameraController:SetCameraType(v57)
		end
	end
end
