function v_u_1.OnLocalPlayerCameraPropertyChanged(p69, p70) -- name: OnLocalPlayerCameraPropertyChanged
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	if p70 == "CameraMode" then
		if v_u_4.LocalPlayer.CameraMode ~= Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then
			if v_u_4.LocalPlayer.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.Classic then
				p69:ActivateCameraController()
			else
				warn("Unhandled value for property player.CameraMode: ", v_u_4.LocalPlayer.CameraMode)
			end
		end
		if not p69.activeCameraController or p69.activeCameraController:GetModuleName() ~= "ClassicCamera" then
			p69:ActivateCameraController()
		end
		if p69.activeCameraController then
			p69.activeCameraController:UpdateForDistancePropertyChange()
			return
		end
	else
		if p70 == "DevComputerCameraMode" or p70 == "DevTouchCameraMode" then
			p69:ActivateCameraController()
			return
		end
		if p70 == "DevCameraOcclusionMode" then
			p69:ActivateOcclusionModule(v_u_4.LocalPlayer.DevCameraOcclusionMode)
			return
		end
		if p70 == "CameraMinZoomDistance" or p70 == "CameraMaxZoomDistance" then
			if p69.activeCameraController then
				p69.activeCameraController:UpdateForDistancePropertyChange()
				return
			end
		else
			if p70 == "DevTouchMovementMode" then
				return
			end
			if p70 == "DevComputerMovementMode" then
				return
			end
			local _ = p70 == "DevEnableMouseLock"
		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.OnUserGameSettingsPropertyChanged(p71, p72) -- name: OnUserGameSettingsPropertyChanged
	if p72 == "ComputerCameraMovementMode" or p72 == "TouchCameraMovementMode" then
		p71:ActivateCameraController()
	end
end

	p73:ActivateCameraController()
end

			v_u_13.resetInputForFrameEnd()
		end
	end
end

function v_u_4.HasToolAncestor(p7, p8) -- name: HasToolAncestor

		return false

end
function v_u_4.IsValidPartToModify(p10, p11) -- name: IsValidPartToModify
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	for _, v12 in v_u_2 do
		if not p11:IsA(v12) then
			continue
		end
		return not p10:HasToolAncestor(p11)
	end
	return false
end
function v_u_4.CachePartsRecursive(p13, p14) -- name: CachePartsRecursive
	if p14 then
		if p13:IsValidPartToModify(p14) then
			p13.cachedParts[p14] = true
			p13.transparencyDirty = true
		end
		for _, v15 in pairs(p14:GetChildren()) do
			p13:CachePartsRecursive(v15)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_4.TeardownTransparency(p16) -- name: TeardownTransparency
	for v17, _ in pairs(p16.cachedParts) do
		v17.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
	end
	p16.cachedParts = {}
	p16.transparencyDirty = true
	p16.lastTransparency = nil
	if p16.descendantAddedConn then
		p16.descendantAddedConn:disconnect()
		p16.descendantAddedConn = nil
	end
	if p16.descendantRemovingConn then
		p16.descendantRemovingConn:disconnect()
		p16.descendantRemovingConn = nil
	end
	for v18, v19 in pairs(p16.toolDescendantAddedConns) do
		v19:Disconnect()
		p16.toolDescendantAddedConns[v18] = nil
	end
	for v20, v21 in pairs(p16.toolDescendantRemovingConns) do
		v21:Disconnect()
		p16.toolDescendantRemovingConns[v20] = nil
	end
end
function v_u_4.SetupTransparency(p_u_22, p_u_23) -- name: SetupTransparency
	p_u_22:TeardownTransparency()
	if p_u_22.descendantAddedConn then
		p_u_22.descendantAddedConn:disconnect()
	end
	p_u_22.descendantAddedConn = p_u_23.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(p24)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (copy) p_u_23
		if p_u_22:IsValidPartToModify(p24) then
			p_u_22.cachedParts[p24] = true
			p_u_22.transparencyDirty = true
		elseif p24:IsA("Tool") then
			if p_u_22.toolDescendantAddedConns[p24] then
				p_u_22.toolDescendantAddedConns[p24]:Disconnect()
			end
			p_u_22.toolDescendantAddedConns[p24] = p24.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(p25)
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_22
				p_u_22.cachedParts[p25] = nil
				if p25:IsA("BasePart") or p25:IsA("Decal") then
					p25.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
				end
			end)
			if p_u_22.toolDescendantRemovingConns[p24] then
				p_u_22.toolDescendantRemovingConns[p24]:disconnect()
			end
			p_u_22.toolDescendantRemovingConns[p24] = p24.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(p26)
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_23, (ref) p_u_22
				wait()
				if p_u_23 and (p26 and (p26:IsDescendantOf(p_u_23) and p_u_22:IsValidPartToModify(p26))) then
					p_u_22.cachedParts[p26] = true
					p_u_22.transparencyDirty = true
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	if p_u_22.descendantRemovingConn then
		p_u_22.descendantRemovingConn:disconnect()
	end
	p_u_22.descendantRemovingConn = p_u_23.DescendantRemoving:connect(function(p27)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22
		if p_u_22.cachedParts[p27] then
			p_u_22.cachedParts[p27] = nil
			p27.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
		end
	end)
	p_u_22:CachePartsRecursive(p_u_23)
end

function v_u_12.GetSubjectCFrame(p24) -- name: GetSubjectCFrame
	local v25 = p24.lastSubjectCFrame
	local v26 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if v26 then
		v26 = v26.CameraSubject
	end
	if not v26 then
		return v25
	end
	if v26:IsA("Humanoid") then
		local v27 = v26:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
		local v28 = v26.CameraOffset
		if p24:GetIsMouseLocked() then
			v28 = Vector3.new()
		end
		local v29 = v26.RootPart
		if v27 and (v26.Parent and v26.Parent:IsA("Model")) then
			v29 = v26.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head") or v29
		end
		if v29 and v29:IsA("BasePart") then
			local v30
			if v26.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
				if v26.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
					v30 = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
					local v31 = v26.RootPart
					if v29 == v31 then
						local v32 = (v31.Size.Y - 2) / 2
						v30 = v30 + Vector3.new(0, v32, 0)
					end
				else
					v30 = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
				end
			else
				v30 = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			end
			v25 = v29.CFrame * CFrame.new((v27 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v30) + v28)
		end
	elseif v26:IsA("BasePart") then
		v25 = v26.CFrame
	elseif v26:IsA("Model") then
		if v26.PrimaryPart then
			v25 = v26:GetPrimaryPartCFrame()
		else
			v25 = CFrame.new()
		end
	end
	if v25 then
		p24.lastSubjectCFrame = v25
	end
	return v25
end

function v_u_12.StepZoom(p39) -- name: StepZoom
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_7
	local v40 = p39.currentSubjectDistance
	local v41 = v_u_9.getZoomDelta()
	if math.abs(v41) > 0 then
		local v42
		if v41 > 0 then
			local v43 = v40 + v41 * (v40 * 0.5 + 1)
			local v44 = p39.FIRST_PERSON_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD
			v42 = math.max(v43, v44)
		else
			local v45 = (v40 + v41) / (1 - v41 * 0.5)
			v42 = math.max(v45, 0.5)
		end
		p39:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(v42 < p39.FIRST_PERSON_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD and 0.5 or v42)
	end
	return v_u_7.GetZoomRadius()
end
function v_u_12.GetSubjectPosition(p46) -- name: GetSubjectPosition
	local v47 = p46.lastSubjectPosition
	local v48 = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if v48 then
		v48 = v48.CameraSubject
	end
	if not v48 then
		return nil
	end
	if v48:IsA("Humanoid") then
		local v49 = v48:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
		local v50 = v48.CameraOffset
		if p46:GetIsMouseLocked() then
			v50 = Vector3.new()
		end
		local v51 = v48.RootPart
		if v49 and (v48.Parent and v48.Parent:IsA("Model")) then
			v51 = v48.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head") or v51
		end
		if v51 and v51:IsA("BasePart") then
			local v52
			if v48.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
				if v48.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
					v52 = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
					if v51 == v48.RootPart then
						local v53 = v48.RootPart.Size.Y / 2 - 1
						v52 = v52 + Vector3.new(0, v53, 0)
					end
				else
					v52 = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
				end
			else
				v52 = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			end
			v47 = v51.CFrame.p + v51.CFrame:vectorToWorldSpace((v49 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v52) + v50)
		end
	elseif v48:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
		v47 = v48.CFrame.p + v48.CFrame:vectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
	elseif v48:IsA("SkateboardPlatform") then
		v47 = v48.CFrame.p + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	elseif v48:IsA("BasePart") then
		v47 = v48.CFrame.p
	elseif v48:IsA("Model") then
		if v48.PrimaryPart then
			v47 = v48:GetPrimaryPartCFrame().p
		else
			v47 = v48:GetModelCFrame().p
		end
	end
	p46.lastSubject = v48
	p46.lastSubjectPosition = v47
	return v47
end

function v_u_12.GamepadZoomPress(p59) -- name: GamepadZoomPress
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	local v60 = p59:GetCameraToSubjectDistance()
	local v61 = v_u_11.CameraMaxZoomDistance
	for v62 = #p59.gamepadZoomLevels, 1, -1 do
		local v63 = p59.gamepadZoomLevels[v62]
		if v61 < v63 then
			continue
		end
		if v63 < v_u_11.CameraMinZoomDistance then
			v63 = v_u_11.CameraMinZoomDistance
			if v61 == v63 then
				break
			end
		end
		if v63 + (v61 - v63) / 2 < v60 then
			p59:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(v63)
			return
		end
		v61 = v63
	end
	p59:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(p59.gamepadZoomLevels[#p59.gamepadZoomLevels])
end

function v_u_12.SetCameraToSubjectDistance(p72, p73) -- name: SetCameraToSubjectDistance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_7
	local v74 = p72.currentSubjectDistance
	if v_u_11.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then
		p72.currentSubjectDistance = 0.5
		if not p72.inFirstPerson then
			p72:EnterFirstPerson()
		end
	else
		local v75 = v_u_11.CameraMinZoomDistance
		local v76 = v_u_11.CameraMaxZoomDistance
		local v77 = math.clamp(p73, v75, v76)
		if v77 < 1 then
			p72.currentSubjectDistance = 0.5
			if not p72.inFirstPerson then
				p72:EnterFirstPerson()
			end
		else
			p72.currentSubjectDistance = v77
			if p72.inFirstPerson then
				p72:LeaveFirstPerson()
			end
		end
	end
	local v78 = v_u_7.SetZoomParameters
	local v79 = p72.currentSubjectDistance
	local v80 = p73 - v74
	v78(v79, (math.sign(v80)))
	return p72.currentSubjectDistance
end

function v_u_12.CalculateNewLookCFrameFromArg(p98, p99, p100) -- name: CalculateNewLookCFrameFromArg
	local v101 = p99 or p98:GetCameraLookVector()
	local v102 = v101.Y
	local v103 = math.asin(v102)
	local v104 = p100.Y
	local v105 = v103 + -1.3962634015954636
	local v106 = v103 + 1.3962634015954636
	local v107 = math.clamp(v104, v105, v106)
	local v108 = Vector2.new(p100.X, v107)
	local v109 = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v101)
	return CFrame.Angles(0, -v108.X, 0) * v109 * CFrame.Angles(-v108.Y, 0, 0)
end

function v_u_12.CalculateNewLookVectorVRFromArg(p113, p114) -- name: CalculateNewLookVectorVRFromArg

	local v116 = Vector2.new(p114.X, 0)
	local v117 = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v115)
	return ((CFrame.Angles(0, -v116.X, 0) * v117 * CFrame.Angles(-v116.Y, 0, 0)).LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).unit
end

function v_u_1.GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame(p31) -- name: GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	local v32 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head)
	local _, v33, _ = v32:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
	local v34 = -v33
	if v_u_8:GetUserCFrameEnabled(Enum.UserCFrame.RightHand) and v_u_8:GetUserCFrameEnabled(Enum.UserCFrame.LeftHand) then
		local v35 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.LeftHand)
		local v36 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.RightHand)
		local v37 = v32.Position - v35.Position
		local v38 = v32.Position - v36.Position
		local v39 = v37.X
		local v40 = v37.Z
		local v41 = -math.atan2(v39, v40)
		local v42 = v38.X
		local v43 = v38.Z
		local v44 = (-math.atan2(v42, v43) - v41 + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v44 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v44 = v44 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v45 = (v41 + v44 / 2 + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v45 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v45 = v45 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v46 = (v34 - p31.currentTorsoAngle + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v46 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v46 = v46 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v47 = (v45 - p31.currentTorsoAngle + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v47 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v47 = v47 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v48
		if v47 > -1.5707963267948966 then
			v48 = v47 < 1.5707963267948966
		else
			v48 = false
		end
		if not v48 then
			v47 = v46
		end
		local v49 = math.min(v47, v46)
		local v50 = math.max(v47, v46)
		local v51 = 0
		if v49 > 0 then
			v50 = v49
		elseif v50 >= 0 then
			v50 = v51
		end
		p31.currentTorsoAngle = v50 + p31.currentTorsoAngle
	else
		p31.currentTorsoAngle = v34
	end
	return CFrame.new(v32.Position) * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(0, -p31.currentTorsoAngle, 0)
end

function v_u_1.calculateRawMoveVector(p68, p69, p70) -- name: calculateRawMoveVector
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_67
	local v71 = v_u_6.CurrentCamera
	if not v71 then
		return p70
	end
	local v72 = v71.CFrame
	if v_u_8.VREnabled and p69.RootPart then
		v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head)
		local v73 = p68:GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame()
		if (v71.Focus.Position - v72.Position).Magnitude < 3 then
			v72 = v72 * v73
		else
			v72 = v71.CFrame * (v73.Rotation + v73.Position * v71.HeadScale)
		end
	end
	if p69:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
		local _, _, _, v78, v75, v76, _, _, v77, _, _, v78 = v72:GetComponents()
		if v77 >= 1 or v77 <= -1 then
			v76 = -v75 * math.sign(v77)
		end
		local v79 = v78 * v78 + v76 * v76
		local v80 = math.sqrt(v79)
		local v81 = (v78 * p70.X + v76 * p70.Z) / v80
		local v82 = (v78 * p70.Z - v76 * p70.X) / v80
		return Vector3.new(v81, 0, v82)
	end
	if not v_u_8.VREnabled then
		return v72:VectorToWorldSpace(p70)
	end
	local v83 = p70.X
	local v84 = p70.Z
	local v85 = Vector3.new(v83, 0, v84)
	if v85.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local v86 = -v_u_67().Y * 1.3962634015954636
	local v87 = -v85.X
	local v88 = -v85.Z
	local v89 = math.atan2(v87, v88)
	local _, v90, _ = v72:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
	local v91 = v89 + v90
	return CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(v86, v91, 0).LookVector
end
function v_u_1.OnRenderStepped(p92, p93) -- name: OnRenderStepped

			local v97

		end

end
function v_u_1.updateVRMoveVector(p100, p101) -- name: updateVRMoveVector

	local v102 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local v103 = (v102.Focus.Position - v102.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 5
	if p101.Magnitude ~= 0 or (not v103 or (not v_u_8.AvatarGestures or (not p100.humanoid or p100.humanoid.Sit))) then
		return p101
	end

	local v105 = v104.Rotation + v104.Position * v102.HeadScale

function v_u_17.TryComputePath(_, p36, p37) -- name: TryComputePath
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v38 = nil
	local v39 = 0
	while not v38 and v39 < 5 do

		v39 = v39 + 1
		if v38.Status == Enum.PathStatus.ClosestNoPath or v38.Status == Enum.PathStatus.ClosestOutOfRange then

		end

			p36 = p36 + (p37 - p36).Unit
			v38 = nil
		end
		if not v38 or v38.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.FailFinishNotEmpty then

		end

		v38 = nil
	end

function v_u_17.OnNavigationRequest(p40, p41, _) -- name: OnNavigationRequest
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10
	local v42 = p41.Position
	local v43 = p40.currentDestination
	local v44 = v42.x
	local v45
	if v44 == v44 and v44 ~= (1 / 0) then
		v45 = v44 ~= (-1 / 0)
	else
		v45 = false
	end
	if v45 then
		local v46 = v42.y
		if v46 == v46 and v46 ~= (1 / 0) then
			v45 = v46 ~= (-1 / 0)
		else
			v45 = false
		end
		if v45 then
			local v47 = v42.z
			if v47 == v47 and v47 ~= (1 / 0) then
				v45 = v47 ~= (-1 / 0)
			else
				v45 = false
			end
		end
	end
	if v45 then
		p40.currentDestination = v42
		local v48 = p40:GetLocalHumanoid()
		if v48 and v48.Torso then
			local v49 = v48.Torso.Position
			if (p40.currentDestination - v49).magnitude < 12 then
				p40:GoToPoint(p40.currentDestination)
			elseif v43 and (p40.currentDestination - v43).magnitude <= 4 then
				if moving then
					p40.currentPoints[#currentPoints] = p40.currentDestination
					return
				end
				p40:GoToPoint(p40.currentDestination)
			else
				local v50 = p40:TryComputePath(v49, p40.currentDestination)
				if v50 then
					p40:StartFollowingPath(v50)

						v_u_10.setCurrentPoints(p40.currentPoints)
						v_u_10.renderPath()
						return
					end
				else
					p40:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v_u_17.OnHeartbeat(p62, p63) -- name: OnHeartbeat
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_14
	local v64 = p62.moveVector
	local v65 = p62:GetLocalHumanoid()
	if v65 and v65.Torso then
		if p62.moving and p62.currentPoints then

			local v67 = (currentPoints[1] - v66) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

			if v68 < 1 then

				local v71 = 0

					if v72 == 1 then
						continue
					end

					v70 = v73
				end

					p62:StopFollowingPath()

						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
					end
					return
				end

					v_u_10.setCurrentPoints(currentPoints)
					v_u_10.renderPath()
				end
				expectedTimeToNextPoint = (currentPoints[1] - v66).magnitude / v65.WalkSpeed
				timeReachedLastPoint = tick()
			else
				if v_u_13 then
					v_u_12.FilterDescendantsInstances = { game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
					local v74 = workspace:Raycast(v66 - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), v69 * 3, v_u_12)
					if v74 then

					end
				else

						local _, v81, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v80, v76)
						local v82 = v81.Y - v66.Y
						if v82 < 6 and v82 > -2 then
							v65.Jump = true
						end
					end
				end
				if tick() - timeReachedLastPoint > expectedTimeToNextPoint + 2 then
					p62:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
					end
					v_u_14:Fire("offtrack")
				end

			end
		end
		local v83 = v64.x
		local v84

			v84 = v83 ~= (-1 / 0)
		else

		end

					v84 = v86 ~= (-1 / 0)
				else

				end
			end
		end
		if v84 then

		end
	end
end

function v_u_5.BindContextActions(p_u_17) -- name: BindContextActions

		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_17

	v_u_2:BindActionAtPriority("moveLeftAction", function(_, p20, _)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_17

		p_u_17.rightValue = p21 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and 1 or 0

	v_u_2:BindActionAtPriority("jumpAction", function(_, p22, _)

		local v24 = p_u_17.jumpEnabled

			v24 = p22 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin

		p_u_17:UpdateJump()
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end, false, p_u_17.CONTROL_ACTION_PRIORITY, Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterJump)
	p_u_17._connectionUtil:trackBoundFunction("moveForwardAction", function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2
		v_u_2:UnbindAction("moveForwardAction")
	end)
	p_u_17._connectionUtil:trackBoundFunction("moveBackwardAction", function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2

	function v_u_124.IsCurrentWaypointReached(_) -- name: IsCurrentWaypointReached
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_124
		local v153
		if v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneNormal == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
			v153 = true
		else

			local v155 = 0.0625 * -v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneNormal:Dot(v_u_124.CurrentHumanoidVelocity)

		end

			v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneDistance = 0

	end

					v_u_124.stopTraverseFunc()

function v_u_21.Enable(p27, p28, p29) -- name: Enable
	if p28 == nil then
		return false
	end

	if p27.enabled == v30 then

			p27:Create(p29)

	p27.enabled = v30
	p27.thumbstickFrame.Visible = v30
	return nil
end

function v_u_21.FadeThumbstick(p32, p33) -- name: FadeThumbstick
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2
	if p33 or not p32.moveTouchObject then
		if p32.isFirstTouch then
			return
		else
			if p32.startImageFadeTween then
				p32.startImageFadeTween:Cancel()
			end
			if p32.endImageFadeTween then
				p32.endImageFadeTween:Cancel()
			end
			for v34 = 1, #p32.middleImages do
				if not p32.middleImageFadeTweens[v34] then
					continue
				end
				p32.middleImageFadeTweens[v34]:Cancel()
			end
			if p33 then
				p32.startImageFadeTween = v_u_10:Create(p32.startImage, v_u_4, {
					["ImageTransparency"] = 0
				})
				p32.startImageFadeTween:Play()
				p32.endImageFadeTween = v_u_10:Create(p32.endImage, v_u_4, {
					["ImageTransparency"] = 0.2
				})
				p32.endImageFadeTween:Play()
				for v35 = 1, #p32.middleImages do
					p32.middleImageFadeTweens[v35] = v_u_10:Create(p32.middleImages[v35], v_u_4, {
						["ImageTransparency"] = v_u_2[v35]
					})
					p32.middleImageFadeTweens[v35]:Play()
				end
			else
				p32.startImageFadeTween = v_u_10:Create(p32.startImage, v_u_4, {
					["ImageTransparency"] = 1
				})
				p32.startImageFadeTween:Play()
				p32.endImageFadeTween = v_u_10:Create(p32.endImage, v_u_4, {
					["ImageTransparency"] = 1
				})
				p32.endImageFadeTween:Play()
				for v36 = 1, #p32.middleImages do
					p32.middleImageFadeTweens[v36] = v_u_10:Create(p32.middleImages[v36], v_u_4, {
						["ImageTransparency"] = 1
					})
					p32.middleImageFadeTweens[v36]:Play()
				end
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v_u_21.DoMove(p48, p49) -- name: DoMove
	local v50
	if p49.Magnitude < p48.radiusOfDeadZone then
		v50 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	else
		local v51 = p49.Unit
		local v52 = (p48.radiusOfMaxSpeed - p49.Magnitude) / p48.radiusOfMaxSpeed
		local v53 = v51 * (1 - math.max(0, v52))
		local v54 = v53.X
		local v55 = v53.Y
		v50 = Vector3.new(v54, 0, v55)
	end
	p48.moveVector = v50
end
function v_u_21.LayoutMiddleImages(p56, p57, p58) -- name: LayoutMiddleImages
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v59 = p56.thumbstickSize / 2 + p56.middleSize
	local v60 = p58 - p57
	local v61 = v60.Magnitude - p56.thumbstickRingSize / 2 - p56.middleSize
	local v62 = v60.Unit
	local v63 = p56.middleSpacing * v_u_3
	local v64 = p56.middleSpacing
	if v63 < v61 then
		v64 = v61 / v_u_3
	end
	for v65 = 1, v_u_3 do
		local v66 = p56.middleImages[v65]
		local v67 = v59 + v64 * (v65 - 2)
		local v68 = v59 + v64 * (v65 - 1)
		if v67 < v61 then
			local v69 = p58 - v62 * v68
			local v70 = 1 - (v68 - v61) / v64
			local v71 = math.clamp(v70, 0, 1)
			v66.Visible = true
			v66.Position = UDim2.new(0, v69.X, 0, v69.Y)
			v66.Size = UDim2.new(0, p56.middleSize * v71, 0, p56.middleSize * v71)
		else
			v66.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

function v_u_21.BindContextActions(p_u_76) -- name: BindContextActions
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_7
	local function v_u_79(p77) -- name: inputBegan
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_76, (ref) v_u_10
		if p_u_76.moveTouchObject then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end
		if not p_u_76:InputInFrame(p77) then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end
		if p_u_76.isFirstTouch then
			p_u_76.isFirstTouch = false
			local v78 = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, 0)

				["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
			}):Play()

				["Size"] = UDim2.new(0, p_u_76.thumbstickSize, 0, p_u_76.thumbstickSize),
				["ImageColor3"] = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			}):Play()
		end
		p_u_76.moveTouchLockedIn = false
		p_u_76.moveTouchObject = p77
		p_u_76.moveTouchStartPosition = p77.Position
		p_u_76.moveTouchFirstChanged = true
		p_u_76:DoFadeInBackground()
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	local function v_u_85(p80) -- name: inputChanged
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_76
		if p80 ~= p_u_76.moveTouchObject then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end
		if p_u_76.moveTouchFirstChanged then
			p_u_76.moveTouchFirstChanged = false
			local v81 = Vector2.new(p80.Position.X - p_u_76.thumbstickFrame.AbsolutePosition.X, p80.Position.Y - p_u_76.thumbstickFrame.AbsolutePosition.Y)
			p_u_76.startImage.Visible = true
			p_u_76.startImage.Position = UDim2.new(0, v81.X, 0, v81.Y)
			p_u_76.endImage.Visible = true
			p_u_76.endImage.Position = p_u_76.startImage.Position
			p_u_76:FadeThumbstick(true)
			p_u_76:MoveStick(p80.Position)
		end
		p_u_76.moveTouchLockedIn = true
		local v82 = Vector2.new(p80.Position.X - p_u_76.moveTouchStartPosition.X, p80.Position.Y - p_u_76.moveTouchStartPosition.Y)
		local v83 = v82.X
		if math.abs(v83) > 0 then
			p_u_76:DoMove(v82)
			p_u_76:MoveStick(p80.Position)
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
		local v84 = v82.Y
		if math.abs(v84) <= 0 then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
		p_u_76:DoMove(v82)
		p_u_76:MoveStick(p80.Position)
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
	v_u_8:BindActionAtPriority("DynamicThumbstickAction", function(_, p86, p87) -- name: handleInput
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_79, (copy) p_u_76
		if p86 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			return v_u_79(p87)
		elseif p86 == Enum.UserInputState.Change then
			if p87 == p_u_76.moveTouchObject then
				return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
			else
				return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
			end
		else
			if p86 == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				if p87 == p_u_76.moveTouchObject then
					p_u_76:OnInputEnded()
					if p_u_76.moveTouchLockedIn then
						return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
					end
				end
				return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
			end
			if p86 == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
				p_u_76:OnInputEnded()
			end
			return
		end
	end, false, v_u_1, Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
	p_u_76.TouchMovedCon = v_u_7.TouchMoved:Connect(function(p88, _)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_85
		v_u_85(p88)
	end)
end

function v_u_2.new() -- name: new
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	local v3 = {
		["_camera"] = nil,
		["_callbacks"] = nil,
		["_connectionUtil"] = nil,
		["_enabled"] = false,
		["_camera"] = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera,
		["_callbacks"] = {},
		["_connectionUtil"] = v_u_1.new()
	}
	local v4 = v_u_2
	return setmetatable(v3, v4)
end
function v_u_2._connectCallbacks(p5) -- name: _connectCallbacks
	p5._camera = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if p5._camera then
		for v6, v7 in p5._callbacks do
			p5._connectionUtil:trackConnection(v6, p5._camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v6):Connect(v7))
			v7()
		end
	end

		p_u_8._enabled = true
		p_u_8._cameraChangedConnection = game.Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_8
			p_u_8:_connectCallbacks()
		end)

	end
end
function v_u_2.Disable(p9) -- name: Disable
	if p9._enabled then
		p9._enabled = false
		if p9._cameraChangedConnection then
			p9._cameraChangedConnection:Disconnect()
			p9._cameraChangedConnection = nil
		end
		p9._connectionUtil:disconnectAll()
	end
end
function v_u_2.Connect(p10, p11, p12) -- name: Connect
	p10._callbacks[p11] = p12
	if p10._camera then
		p10._connectionUtil:trackConnection(p11, p10._camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p11):Connect(p12))
	end
end
function v_u_2.Disconnect(p13, p14) -- name: Disconnect
	p13._connectionUtil:disconnect(p14)
	p13._callbacks[p14] = nil
end
function v_u_2.getCamera(p15) -- name: getCamera
	return p15._camera
end
return v_u_2

function v_u_1.new() -- name: new
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v2 = v_u_1
	local v3 = setmetatable({}, v2)
	v3._connections = {}
	return v3
end
function v_u_1.trackConnection(p4, p5, p_u_6) -- name: trackConnection
	if p4._connections[p5] then
		p4._connections[p5]()
	end
	p4._connections[p5] = function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_6
		p_u_6:Disconnect()
	end
end
function v_u_1.trackBoundFunction(p7, p8, p9) -- name: trackBoundFunction
	if p7._connections[p8] then
		p7._connections[p8]()
	end
	p7._connections[p8] = p9
end
function v_u_1.disconnect(p10, p11) -- name: disconnect
	if p10._connections[p11] then
		p10._connections[p11]()
		p10._connections[p11] = nil
	end
end
function v_u_1.disconnectAll(p12) -- name: disconnectAll
	for _, v13 in pairs(p12._connections) do
		v13()
	end
	p12._connections = {}
end
return v_u_1

function v_u_1.ActivateCameraController(p56) -- name: ActivateCameraController
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_29

		if p56.activeCameraController then
			p56.activeCameraController:Enable(false)
			p56.activeCameraController = nil
		end
	else

			v58 = p56:GetCameraMovementModeFromSettings()

		elseif v57 == Enum.CameraType.Attach or (v57 == Enum.CameraType.Watch or v57 == Enum.CameraType.Fixed) then
			v59 = v_u_16
		else

		end
		if not v59 then
			if v_u_7.VREnabled then
				v59 = v_u_18
			elseif v58 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic or (v58 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Follow or (v58 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Default or v58 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.CameraToggle)) then
				v59 = v_u_14
			else
				if v58 ~= Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Orbital then
					warn("ActivateCameraController did not select a module.")
					return
				end
				v59 = v_u_15
			end
		end
		if p56:ShouldUseVehicleCamera() then
			if v_u_7.VREnabled then
				v59 = v_u_19
			else
				v59 = v_u_17
			end
		end
		local v60
		if v_u_24[v59] then
			v60 = v_u_24[v59]
			if v_u_29 then
				if v60.Reset and p56.activeCameraController ~= v60 then
					v60:Reset()
				end
			elseif v60.Reset then
				v60:Reset()
			end
		else
			v60 = v59.new()
			v_u_24[v59] = v60
		end
		if p56.activeCameraController then
			if p56.activeCameraController == v60 then
				if not p56.activeCameraController:GetEnabled() then
					p56.activeCameraController:Enable(true)
				end
			else
				if v60.HandleSubjectDistance then
					v60:HandleSubjectDistance(p56.activeCameraController)
				end

function v_u_4.getLooseBoundingSphere(p33) -- name: getLooseBoundingSphere

function v_u_61._updateStepRotation(p99, p100) -- name: _updateStepRotation

function v_u_7.CalculateNewLookVector(p68, p69, p70) -- name: CalculateNewLookVector
	local v71 = p69 or p68:GetCameraLookVector()

	local v73 = math.asin(v72)
	local v74 = p70.Y
	local v75 = v73 - 1.3962634015954636
	local v76 = v73 - -1.3962634015954636
	local v77 = math.clamp(v74, v75, v76)
	local v78 = Vector2.new(p70.X, v77)
	local v79 = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v71)

function v_u_7.Update(p80, p81) -- name: Update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5
	local v82 = tick()
	local v83 = v82 - p80.lastUpdate
	local v84 = v_u_4.getRotation(p81) ~= Vector2.new()
	local v85 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local v86 = v85.CFrame
	local v87 = v85.Focus
	local v88 = v_u_5.LocalPlayer
	local v89
	if v85 then
		v89 = v85.CameraSubject
	else
		v89 = v85
	end
	local v90
	if v89 then
		v90 = v89:IsA("VehicleSeat")
	else
		v90 = v89
	end
	local v91
	if v89 then
		v91 = v89:IsA("SkateboardPlatform")
	else
		v91 = v89
	end
	if p80.lastUpdate == nil or v83 > 1 then
		p80.lastCameraTransform = nil
	end
	if v84 then
		p80.lastUserPanCamera = tick()
	end
	local v92 = p80:GetSubjectPosition()
	if v92 and (v88 and v85) then
		if p80.gamepadDollySpeedMultiplier ~= 1 then
			p80:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(p80.currentSubjectDistance * p80.gamepadDollySpeedMultiplier)
		end
		v87 = CFrame.new(v92)
		local v93 = v_u_4.getRotation(p81)
		p80.curAzimuthRad = p80.curAzimuthRad - v93.X
		if p80.useAzimuthLimits then
			local v94 = p80.curAzimuthRad
			local v95 = p80.minAzimuthAbsoluteRad
			local v96 = p80.maxAzimuthAbsoluteRad
			p80.curAzimuthRad = math.clamp(v94, v95, v96)
		else
			local v97
			if p80.curAzimuthRad == 0 then
				v97 = 0
			else
				local v98 = p80.curAzimuthRad
				local v99 = math.sign(v98)
				local v100 = p80.curAzimuthRad
				v97 = v99 * (math.abs(v100) % 6.283185307179586) or 0
			end
			p80.curAzimuthRad = v97
		end
		local v101 = p80.curElevationRad + v93.Y
		local v102 = p80.minElevationRad
		local v103 = p80.maxElevationRad
		p80.curElevationRad = math.clamp(v101, v102, v103)
		local v104 = v92 + p80.currentSubjectDistance * (CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(-p80.curElevationRad, p80.curAzimuthRad, 0) * Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))

		p80.lastCameraFocus = v87

			p80.lastSubjectCFrame = v89.CFrame
		else
			p80.lastSubjectCFrame = nil
		end
	end
	p80.lastUpdate = v82

end

function v_u_12.GetSubjectCFrame(p24) -- name: GetSubjectCFrame
	local v25 = p24.lastSubjectCFrame
	local v26 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if v26 then
		v26 = v26.CameraSubject
	end
	if not v26 then
		return v25
	end
	if v26:IsA("Humanoid") then
		local v27 = v26:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
		local v28 = v26.CameraOffset

			v28 = Vector3.new()
		end

			v29 = v26.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head") or v29

			if v26.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then

					if v29 == v31 then

					v30 = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)

			end

		end

	elseif v26:IsA("Model") then

			v25 = v26:GetPrimaryPartCFrame()

end

function v_u_12.StepZoom(p39) -- name: StepZoom
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_7
	local v40 = p39.currentSubjectDistance
	local v41 = v_u_9.getZoomDelta()
	if math.abs(v41) > 0 then
		local v42
		if v41 > 0 then
			local v43 = v40 + v41 * (v40 * 0.5 + 1)
			local v44 = p39.FIRST_PERSON_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD
			v42 = math.max(v43, v44)
		else
			local v45 = (v40 + v41) / (1 - v41 * 0.5)
			v42 = math.max(v45, 0.5)
		end
		p39:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(v42 < p39.FIRST_PERSON_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD and 0.5 or v42)
	end
	return v_u_7.GetZoomRadius()
end
function v_u_12.GetSubjectPosition(p46) -- name: GetSubjectPosition
	local v47 = p46.lastSubjectPosition
	local v48 = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if v48 then
		v48 = v48.CameraSubject
	end
	if not v48 then
		return nil
	end
	if v48:IsA("Humanoid") then
		local v49 = v48:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
		local v50 = v48.CameraOffset
		if p46:GetIsMouseLocked() then
			v50 = Vector3.new()
		end
		local v51 = v48.RootPart
		if v49 and (v48.Parent and v48.Parent:IsA("Model")) then
			v51 = v48.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head") or v51
		end
		if v51 and v51:IsA("BasePart") then
			local v52
			if v48.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
				if v48.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
					v52 = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
					if v51 == v48.RootPart then
						local v53 = v48.RootPart.Size.Y / 2 - 1
						v52 = v52 + Vector3.new(0, v53, 0)
					end
				else
					v52 = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
				end
			else
				v52 = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			end
			v47 = v51.CFrame.p + v51.CFrame:vectorToWorldSpace((v49 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v52) + v50)
		end
	elseif v48:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
		v47 = v48.CFrame.p + v48.CFrame:vectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
	elseif v48:IsA("SkateboardPlatform") then
		v47 = v48.CFrame.p + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	elseif v48:IsA("BasePart") then
		v47 = v48.CFrame.p
	elseif v48:IsA("Model") then
		if v48.PrimaryPart then
			v47 = v48:GetPrimaryPartCFrame().p
		else
			v47 = v48:GetModelCFrame().p
		end
	end
	p46.lastSubject = v48
	p46.lastSubjectPosition = v47
	return v47
end

function v_u_12.GamepadZoomPress(p59) -- name: GamepadZoomPress
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	local v60 = p59:GetCameraToSubjectDistance()
	local v61 = v_u_11.CameraMaxZoomDistance
	for v62 = #p59.gamepadZoomLevels, 1, -1 do
		local v63 = p59.gamepadZoomLevels[v62]
		if v61 < v63 then
			continue
		end
		if v63 < v_u_11.CameraMinZoomDistance then
			v63 = v_u_11.CameraMinZoomDistance
			if v61 == v63 then
				break
			end
		end
		if v63 + (v61 - v63) / 2 < v60 then
			p59:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(v63)
			return
		end
		v61 = v63
	end
	p59:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(p59.gamepadZoomLevels[#p59.gamepadZoomLevels])
end

function v_u_1.calculateRawMoveVector(p68, p69, p70) -- name: calculateRawMoveVector
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_67
	local v71 = v_u_6.CurrentCamera
	if not v71 then
		return p70
	end
	local v72 = v71.CFrame

		else

	local v84 = p70.Z

		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

			local v47 = v42.z
			if v47 == v47 and v47 ~= (1 / 0) then
				v45 = v47 ~= (-1 / 0)
			else
				v45 = false
			end
		end
	end
	if v45 then
		p40.currentDestination = v42
		local v48 = p40:GetLocalHumanoid()
		if v48 and v48.Torso then
			local v49 = v48.Torso.Position
			if (p40.currentDestination - v49).magnitude < 12 then
				p40:GoToPoint(p40.currentDestination)
			elseif v43 and (p40.currentDestination - v43).magnitude <= 4 then
				if moving then
					p40.currentPoints[#currentPoints] = p40.currentDestination
					return
				end
				p40:GoToPoint(p40.currentDestination)
			else
				local v50 = p40:TryComputePath(v49, p40.currentDestination)
				if v50 then
					p40:StartFollowingPath(v50)
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.setCurrentPoints(p40.currentPoints)
						v_u_10.renderPath()
						return
					end
				else
					p40:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_17.OnJumpAction(p51, _, p52, _) -- name: OnJumpAction
	if p52 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		p51.isJumping = true
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end
function v_u_17.BindJumpAction(p_u_53, p54) -- name: BindJumpAction
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	if p54 then
		if not p_u_53.isJumpBound then
			p_u_53.isJumpBound = true
			v_u_6:BindActionAtPriority("VRJumpAction", function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_53

function v_u_17.ControlCharacterGamepad(p55, _, p56, p57) -- name: ControlCharacterGamepad
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_14
	if p57.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 then
		if p56 ~= Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
			if p56 == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				p55.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				if p55:ShouldUseNavigationLaser() then
					p55:BindJumpAction(false)
					p55:SetLaserPointerMode("Navigation")
				end
				if p55.moveLatch then
					p55.moveLatch = false
					v_u_14:Fire("offtrack")
				end
			else
				p55:StopFollowingPath()
				if v_u_10 then
					v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
				end
				if p55:ShouldUseNavigationLaser() then
					p55:BindJumpAction(true)
					p55:SetLaserPointerMode("Hidden")
				end
				if p57.Position.magnitude > 0.22 then
					local v58 = p57.Position.X
					local v59 = -p57.Position.Y
					p55.moveVector = Vector3.new(v58, 0, v59)
					if p55.moveVector.magnitude > 0 then
						local v60 = p55.moveVector.unit
						local v61 = p57.Position.magnitude
						p55.moveVector = v60 * math.min(1, v61)
					end
					p55.moveLatch = true
				end
			end
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
		p55.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
end
function v_u_17.OnHeartbeat(p62, p63) -- name: OnHeartbeat
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_14
	local v64 = p62.moveVector
	local v65 = p62:GetLocalHumanoid()
	if v65 and v65.Torso then
		if p62.moving and p62.currentPoints then
			local v66 = v65.Torso.Position
			local v67 = (currentPoints[1] - v66) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			local v68 = v67.magnitude
			local v69 = v67 / v68
			if v68 < 1 then
				local v70 = currentPoints[1]
				local v71 = 0
				for v72, v73 in pairs(currentPoints) do
					if v72 == 1 then
						continue
					end
					v71 = v71 + (v73 - v70).magnitude / v65.WalkSpeed
					v70 = v73
				end
				table.remove(currentPoints, 1)
				currentPointIdx = currentPointIdx + 1
				if #currentPoints == 0 then
					p62:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
					end
					return
				end
				if v_u_10 then
					v_u_10.setCurrentPoints(currentPoints)
					v_u_10.renderPath()
				end
				expectedTimeToNextPoint = (currentPoints[1] - v66).magnitude / v65.WalkSpeed
				timeReachedLastPoint = tick()
			else
				if v_u_13 then
					v_u_12.FilterDescendantsInstances = { game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
					local v74 = workspace:Raycast(v66 - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), v69 * 3, v_u_12)
					if v74 then
						local v75 = workspace:Raycast(v74.Position + v69 * 0.5 + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(-0, -100, -0), v_u_12).Position.Y - v66.Y
						if v75 < 6 and v75 > -2 then
							v65.Jump = true
						end
					end
				else
					local v76 = { game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
					local v77 = Ray.new(v66 - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), v69 * 3)
					local v78, v79, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v77, v76)
					if v78 then
						local v80 = Ray.new(v79 + v69 * 0.5 + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(-0, -100, -0))
						local _, v81, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v80, v76)
						local v82 = v81.Y - v66.Y
						if v82 < 6 and v82 > -2 then
							v65.Jump = true
						end
					end
				end
				if tick() - timeReachedLastPoint > expectedTimeToNextPoint + 2 then
					p62:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
					end
					v_u_14:Fire("offtrack")
				end
				v64 = p62.moveVector:Lerp(v69, p63 * 10)
			end
		end
		local v83 = v64.x
		local v84
		if v83 == v83 and v83 ~= (1 / 0) then
			v84 = v83 ~= (-1 / 0)
		else
			v84 = false
		end
		if v84 then
			local v85 = v64.y
			if v85 == v85 and v85 ~= (1 / 0) then
				v84 = v85 ~= (-1 / 0)
			else
				v84 = false
			end
			if v84 then
				local v86 = v64.z
				if v86 == v86 and v86 ~= (1 / 0) then
					v84 = v86 ~= (-1 / 0)
				else
					v84 = false
				end
			end
		end
		if v84 then
			p62.moveVector = v64
		end
	end
end

		p87:BindJumpAction(false)
		p87:SetLaserPointerMode("Navigation")

		p87:SetLaserPointerMode("Hidden")

end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	p_u_88.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	p_u_88.isJumping = false

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_88

		end
		if p_u_88.heartbeatConn then

			p_u_88.heartbeatConn = nil
		end
		if p_u_88.userCFrameEnabledConn then

		end
		p_u_88.enabled = false
	end
end

function v_u_9.Create(p_u_28) -- name: Create

		end

		else

			p_u_28.jumpButton.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(1, 146)
			p_u_28.jumpButton.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(144, 144)
		end
		local function v36() -- name: ResizeJumpButton
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_7
			local v29 = p_u_28.parentUIFrame.AbsoluteSize.x
			local v30 = p_u_28.parentUIFrame.AbsoluteSize.y
			local v31 = math.min(v29, v30) <= 500
			if v_u_5 and v_u_6.isEnabled() then
				local v32 = v31 and 72 or 120
				local v33 = -v32 - (v31 and 64 or 100)
				local v34 = -v32 - (v31 and 64 or 112)
				p_u_28.jumpButton.Image = v_u_7[1]

						local v162 = v_u_124.pointList[v_u_124.CurrentPoint - 1]
						local v163 = v158.Position - v162.Position
						local v164 = v159.Position - v158.Position
						v161 = Vector2.new(v163.x, v163.z).Unit:Dot(Vector2.new(v164.x, v164.z).Unit) < 0.996
					end
					if v161 then
						v_u_124.Humanoid.FreeFalling:Wait()
						wait(0.1)
					end
				end
				v_u_124:MoveToNextWayPoint(v158, v159, v157)
			end
		else
			v_u_124.PathFailed:Fire()
			v_u_124:Cleanup()
			return
		end
	end
	function v_u_124.MoveToNextWayPoint(_, p165, p166, p167) -- name: MoveToNextWayPoint
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_124, (ref) v_u_6
		v_u_124.CurrentWaypointPlaneNormal = p165.Position - p166.Position

		end

	end
	function v_u_124.Start(_, p171) -- name: Start
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_124, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_16
		if v_u_124.AgentCanFollowPath then

				return
			else

		end
	end
	local v178 = v_u_124.TargetPoint + v_u_124.TargetSurfaceNormal * 1.5
	if v_u_15 then

		local v180

			end
			table.insert(v182, v183)
			v180 = v_u_41
		end
		v179.FilterDescendantsInstances = v180
		local v184 = v_u_11:Raycast(v178, Vector3.new(-0, -50, -0), v_u_24)
		if v184 then
			v_u_124.TargetPoint = v184.Position
		end
	else
		local v185 = Ray.new(v178, Vector3.new(0, -50, 0))
		local v186 = v_u_11
		local v187

			v187 = v_u_41
		else

			assert(v188, "")

			if v190 then

			end
			table.insert(v189, v190)
			v187 = v_u_41
		end
		local v191, v192 = v186:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v185, v187)
		if v191 then
			v_u_124.TargetPoint = v192
		end
	end
	v_u_124:ComputePath()
	return v_u_124
end

function OnTap(p209, p210, p211) -- name: OnTap
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_41, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_197, (ref) v_u_198, (ref) v_u_199, (copy) v_u_193, (copy) v_u_208, (ref) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_196
	local v212 = v_u_11.CurrentCamera
	local v213 = v_u_22.Character
	local v214 = v_u_22

		v215 = v214.Character

	end

				if v_u_15 then

							v224 = v_u_22.Character

								end

						end
					end
					if not v225 then
						continue
					end
					if p211 and (v219 and (v_u_10:GetCore("AvatarContextMenuEnabled") and v_u_9:GetPlayerFromCharacter(v219.Parent))) then
						if v_u_197 then
							v_u_197:Cancel()
							v_u_197 = nil
						end
						if v_u_198 then
							v_u_198:Disconnect()
							v_u_198 = nil
						end
						if v_u_199 then
							v_u_199:Disconnect()
							v_u_199 = nil
						end
						return
					elseif v226 and v213 then
						local v229 = v226.Position
						if p210 then
							v220 = nil
						else
							p210 = v229
						end
						if v_u_197 then
							v_u_197:Cancel()
							v_u_197 = nil
						end
						if v_u_198 then
							v_u_198:Disconnect()
							v_u_198 = nil
						end

							v_u_199:Disconnect()
							v_u_199 = nil
						end
						local v230 = v_u_193(p210, v226.Normal)
						if v230:IsValidPath() then
							v_u_208(v230, p210, v220, v213)
						else
							v230:Cleanup()

								v_u_197:Cancel()
							end
							if v_u_17 then
								v_u_23.PlayFailureAnimation()
							end
							v_u_23.DisplayFailureWaypoint(p210)
						end
					else
						return
					end
				end
				local v231 = Ray.new(v218.Origin, v218.Direction * 1000)
				local v232 = v_u_25.Raycast
				local v233 = true
				local v234
				if v_u_41 then
					v234 = v_u_41

					end
					table.insert(v236, v237)
					v234 = v_u_41
				end
				local v238, v239, v240 = v232(v231, v233, v234)
				local v241, v242 = v_u_25.FindCharacterAncestor(v238)
				if p211 and (v242 and (v_u_10:GetCore("AvatarContextMenuEnabled") and v_u_9:GetPlayerFromCharacter(v242.Parent))) then

					end
					if v_u_198 then

					end
					if v_u_199 then

					end
					return
				end

					v241 = nil
				else
					p210 = v239
				end
				if p210 and v213 then
					if v_u_197 then
						v_u_197:Cancel()
						v_u_197 = nil
					end
					if v_u_198 then
						v_u_198:Disconnect()
						v_u_198 = nil
					end
					if v_u_199 then
						v_u_199:Disconnect()
						v_u_199 = nil
					end
					local v243 = v_u_193(p210, v240)
					if v243:IsValidPath() then
						v_u_208(v243, p210, v241, v213)
					else
						v243:Cleanup()

							v_u_197:Cancel()
						end
						if v_u_17 then
							v_u_23.PlayFailureAnimation()
						end
						v_u_23.DisplayFailureWaypoint(p210)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			local v244 = #p209 >= 2 and (v212 and v_u_196(v213))
			if v244 then
				v244:Activate()
			end
		end
	end
end

			p5._connectionUtil:trackConnection(v6, p5._camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v6):Connect(v7))
			v7()
		end
	end
end
function v_u_2.Enable(p_u_8) -- name: Enable
	if not p_u_8._enabled then
		p_u_8._enabled = true
		p_u_8._cameraChangedConnection = game.Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_8
			p_u_8:_connectCallbacks()
		end)
		p_u_8:_connectCallbacks()
	end
end
function v_u_2.Disable(p9) -- name: Disable
	if p9._enabled then
		p9._enabled = false
		if p9._cameraChangedConnection then
			p9._cameraChangedConnection:Disconnect()
			p9._cameraChangedConnection = nil
		end
		p9._connectionUtil:disconnectAll()
	end
end
function v_u_2.Connect(p10, p11, p12) -- name: Connect
	p10._callbacks[p11] = p12
	if p10._camera then
		p10._connectionUtil:trackConnection(p11, p10._camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p11):Connect(p12))
	end
end
function v_u_2.Disconnect(p13, p14) -- name: Disconnect
	p13._connectionUtil:disconnect(p14)
	p13._callbacks[p14] = nil
end
function v_u_2.getCamera(p15) -- name: getCamera
	return p15._camera
end
return v_u_2

-- Players.xnon5555.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.CommonUtils.ConnectionUtil [ModuleScript]
local v_u_1 = {}
v_u_1.__index = v_u_1
function v_u_1.new() -- name: new
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v2 = v_u_1
	local v3 = setmetatable({}, v2)
	v3._connections = {}
	return v3
end
function v_u_1.trackConnection(p4, p5, p_u_6) -- name: trackConnection
	if p4._connections[p5] then
		p4._connections[p5]()
	end
	p4._connections[p5] = function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_6
		p_u_6:Disconnect()
	end
end
function v_u_1.trackBoundFunction(p7, p8, p9) -- name: trackBoundFunction
	if p7._connections[p8] then
		p7._connections[p8]()
	end
	p7._connections[p8] = p9
end
function v_u_1.disconnect(p10, p11) -- name: disconnect
	if p10._connections[p11] then
		p10._connections[p11]()
		p10._connections[p11] = nil
	end
end
function v_u_1.disconnectAll(p12) -- name: disconnectAll
	for _, v13 in pairs(p12._connections) do
		v13()
	end
	p12._connections = {}
end
return v_u_1
